passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alî Zainul-`Âbidîn bin al-Husainis-Sibth, wulida bil-Madînati yaumal-khamîs 5 Sya`bân sanata 38 H wa nasya'a bihâ, wa luqqiba bi-Zainil-`Âbidîn likatsrati `ibâdatih, wa yulaqqabu aidhan bis-Sajjâd likatsrati sujûdih, fakâna yushallî fî kulli yaumin wa lailatin alfa rak`ah, wa kâna imâman jalîlan halîman karîmâ, wa kâna katsîral-khaufi wal-khasyyah; lammâ hajja wa qâla: labbaikallâhumma labbaik saqatha maghsyiyyan `alaih, wa idzâ tawadhdha'a yashfarru launuhû wa idzâ qâma ilash-shalâti akhadzat-hu ra`dah, tuwuffiya bil-Madînati sanata 92 wa qîla: 94 H, wa dufina bil-Baqî`.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Ali Zainal ‘Abidin bin al-Husain, sang cucu Nabi ﷺ. Beliau lahir di Madinah pada hari Kamis, 5 Sya‘ban 38 H, dan tumbuh besar di sana. Beliau dijuluki Zainal ‘Abidin karena banyaknya ibadah beliau, dan dijuluki pula as-Sajjad karena banyaknya sujud beliau. Beliau biasa melakukan shalat seribu rakaat dalam sehari semalam. Beliau adalah seorang imam yang agung, santun, dan dermawan, yang hatinya dipenuhi rasa khauf dan khasyyah kepada Allah; ketika berhaji dan mengucapkan “Labbaik Allahumma labbaik”, beliau jatuh pingsan. Setiap kali berwudhu wajah beliau memucat, dan setiap kali berdiri untuk shalat tubuh beliau gemetar. Beliau wafat di Madinah pada tahun 92 H — ada yang mengatakan 94 H — dan dimakamkan di Baqi‘.
passages.en: Imam Ali Zayn al-Abidin, son of al-Husayn as-Sibt, was born in Madinah on Thursday, 5th Shaban, 38 AH (659), and raised there. He was known as “Zayn al-Abidin (the Beauty of the Devotees)” due to his great worship. He is also called “as-Sajjad” due to his abundant prostrations. He would pray 1000 rakats every day. He was a sublime, clement and generous Imam. He had great fear of Allah. When he went for Hajj and said, “Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk (Here I am at Your service, O Allah! Here I am at Your service!)”, he fainted. When he would make wudhu (ablution), he would become pale. When he stood for prayer, he would tremble. He passed away in Madinah in 92 AH. Another opinion is that it was 94 AH. He was buried in al-Baqi.

passages.sub: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir
passages.ar: هو الإمام القدوة محمد الباقِر بن علي زين العابدين، وُلد بالمدينة يوم الجمعة ٣ صفر سنة ٥٧هـ، عدّه الإمام النّسائي وغيره من فقهاء التابعين، كانَ مجتهدًا في العبادة، ويُقال له: الباقر لأنّه بقرَ العلم (أي: لتوسّعه في العلم)، وكانَ يُصلّي في اليوم والليلة مائة وخمسين ركعة، وله كلام فائق ووصايا نافعة، توفي سنة ١١٧هـ وقيل غيرها، ودُفن بالبقيع.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-qudwah Muhammadunil-Bâqir bin `Alî Zainil-`Âbidîn, wulida bil-Madînati yaumal-jum`ati 3 Shafar sanata 57 H, `addahul-Imâmun-Nasâ'î wa ghairuhû min fuqahâ'it-tâbi`în, kâna mujtahidan fil-`ibâdah, wa yuqâlu lah: al-Bâqir li'annahû baqaral-`ilma (ay: litawassu`ihî fil-`ilm), wa kâna yushallî fil-yaumi wal-lailati mi'atan wa khamsîna rak`ah, wa lahû kalâmun fâ'iqun wa washâyâ nâfi`ah, tuwuffiya sanata 117 H wa qîla ghairuhâ, wa dufina bil-Baqî`.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah seorang imam dan panutan, Muhammad al-Baqir bin ‘Ali Zainal ‘Abidin. Beliau lahir di Madinah pada hari Jumat, 3 Shafar 57 H. Imam an-Nasa'i dan yang lain memasukkan beliau sebagai fuqaha dari kalangan tabi‘in. Beliau sangat bersungguh-sungguh dalam ibadah. Beliau digelari al-Baqir karena beliau membelah ilmu (maksudnya: karena luasnya ilmu beliau). Beliau biasa melaksanakan shalat 150 rakaat dalam sehari semalam. Beliau memiliki kata-kata yang mulia dan wasiat-wasiat yang bermanfaat. Beliau wafat pada tahun 117 H (ada pula pendapat lain) dan dimakamkan di Baqi‘.
passages.en: The Imam and exemplar, Muhammad al-Baqir bin Ali Zayn al-Abidin, was born in Madinah on Friday 3rd Safar, 57 AH (676). Imam an-Nasa`i and others deemed him to be of the jurists of the Tabi'in (the generation after the Sahaba). He would strive greatly in worship. He is called “al-Baqir” (the one who had ripped open all knowledge and reached its source) because of his vast knowledge. Every day and night, he would pray 150 rakats. He spoke exquisite words and gave beneficial counsels. He passed away in 117 AH. There are other opinions about the year as well. He was buried in al-Baqi.

passages.sub: Imam Jafar as-Sadiq
passages.ar:
هو الإمام المُجمع على جلالته ومعرفته: جعفر الصادق بن محمد الباقر بن علي زين العابدين، لُقّب بالصّادق لصدقه، ولد بالمدينة في ربيع الأول سنة ٨٠هـ، ونشأ بها وصحب أباه وتأدب به، وكانَ بارعًا في جميع العلوم، وكان حليمًا كريمًا مُهابًا، قالَ عمر بن المقدام:
"كنتُ إذا رأيته علمتُ أنّهُ من سُلالة النّبيّين"،
وله كلام ومواعظ قيّمة، فمن كلامه:
"تأخير التوبة اغترار، وطول التسويف حيره"،
توفي بالمدينة في شوال سنة ١٤٨هـ ودُفن بالبقيع.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-mujma`u `alâ jalâlatihî wa ma`rifatih: Ja`farunish-Shâdiq bin Muhammadinil-Bâqir bin `Alî Zainil-`Âbidîn, luqqiba bish-Shâdiq lishidqih, wulida bil-Madînati fî Rabî`il-Awwal sanata 80 H, wa nasya'a bihâ wa shahiba abâhu wa ta'addaba bih, wa kâna bâri`an fî jamî`il-`ulûm, wa kâna halîman karîman muhâbâ, qâla `Umar bin al-Miqdâm: "kuntu idzâ ra'aituhû `alimtu annahû min sulâlatin-nabiyyîn", wa lahû kalâmun wa mawâ`izhu qayyimah, famin kalâmih: "ta'khîrut-taubati ightirâr, wa thûlut-taswîfi hîrah", tuwuffiya bil-Madînati fî Syawwâl sanata 148 H wa dufina bil-Baqî`.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah sosok imam yang disepakati keagungan dan makrifatnya: Ja‘far ash-Shadiq bin Muhammad al-Baqir bin ‘Ali Zainal ‘Abidin. Beliau dijuluki ash-Shadiq karena kejujurannya. Beliau lahir di Madinah pada bulan Rabi‘ul Awwal tahun 80 H dan tumbuh besar di sana, menyertai ayahnya dan mengambil adab darinya. Beliau mahir dalam semua bidang ilmu, sangat santun, dermawan, dan berwibawa. ‘Umar bin al-Miqdam berkata, “Setiap kali aku melihat beliau, aku tahu bahwa beliau berasal dari keturunan para nabi.” Beliau memiliki kata-kata dan nasihat yang berharga, di antaranya: “Menunda taubat adalah ketertipuan, dan panjangnya angan menunda-nunda adalah kebingungan.” Beliau wafat di Madinah pada bulan Syawwal tahun 148 H dan dimakamkan di Baqi‘.
passages.en: He is the Imam who is unanimously acknowledged for his magnificence and direct knowledge of Allah. He is Jafar as-Sadiq, son of Muhammad al-Baqir, son of Ali Zayn al-Abidin. He was called as-Sadiq (the Truthful) because of his truthfulness. He was born in Madinah in Rabi al-Awwal in 80 AH (699), and raised there. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions. He excelled in all fields of knowledge. He was clement, generous and awesome. Umar bin al-Miqdam said, “Whenever I saw him, I knew he was from the progeny of the Prophets.” He spoke precious words and counsels. He said: To postpone repentance is delusion. Prolonged postponement is confusion. He passed away in Madinah in Shawwal in 148 AH (765). He was buried in al-Baqi.

passages.sub: Imam Ali al-Uraydhi
passages.ar: هو الإمام العالم العامل، المُتضلّع من أنواع العلوم: علي العُريضي بن جعفر الصادق، ولد بالمدينة ونشأ بها، وصحب أباه وتأدب به ولازمه إلى أن انتقل والده إلى الدار الآخرة، ثم سكنَ العُرَيْض متوطنًا بها إلى وفاته، وكان عالمًا عابدًا جوادًا سخيًّا أسند عن آبائه الكرام، خرّجَ له الإمام أحمد في مُسنده، وأسندَ له الإمام الترمذي في كتاب (السُّنَن) حديثًا، وكذلك القاضي عياض في كتابه (الشِّفا)، وتعمّر قريبًا من المائة، توفي بالمدينة حدود سنة ٢١٠هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-`âlimul-`âmil, al-mutadhalli`u min anwâ`il-`ulûm: `Aliyyunil-`Uraidhî bin Ja`farinish-Shâdiq, wulida bil-Madînati wa nasya'a bihâ, wa shahiba abâhu wa ta'addaba bihî wa lâzamahû ilâ anintaqala wâliduhû ilad-dâril-âkhirah, tsumma sakanal-`Uraidha mutawaththinan bihâ ilâ wafâtih, wa kâna `âliman `âbidan jawâdan sakhiyyan asnada `an âbâ'ihil-kirâm, kharraja lahul-Imâm Ahmad fî Musnadih, wa asnada lahul-Imâmut-Tirmidzî fî kitâb (as-Sunan) hadîtsâ, wa kadzâlikal-Qâdhî `Iyâdh fî kitâbih (asy-Syifâ), wa ta`ammara qarîban minal-mi'ah, tuwuffiya bil-Madînati hudûda sanati 210 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah imam yang alim dan mengamalkan ilmunya, menguasai berbagai jenis ilmu: ‘Ali al-‘Uraidhi bin Ja‘far ash-Shadiq. Beliau lahir dan besar di Madinah, menyertai ayahnya, mengambil adab darinya, dan terus mendampinginya hingga sang ayah berpulang ke negeri akhirat. Setelah itu beliau menetap di ‘Uraidh hingga wafat. Beliau adalah seorang alim, ahli ibadah, dermawan, dan pemurah, yang meriwayatkan dari para leluhurnya yang mulia. Imam Ahmad meriwayatkan darinya dalam Musnad-nya, Imam at-Tirmidzi meriwayatkan hadits darinya dalam kitab as-Sunan, begitu pula Qadhi ‘Iyadh dalam kitabnya, asy-Syifa. Umur beliau mencapai hampir seratus tahun. Beliau wafat di Madinah sekitar tahun 210 H.
passages.en: He is the Imam, the scholar who acted on his knowledge, the expert in various fields of knowledge: Ali al-Uraydhi, son of Jafar as-Sadiq. He was born and raised in Madinah. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions and adhere to until his father passed on to the abode of the hereafter. He thereafter settled down in Al-Uraydh, until he passed away. He was a scholar, devotee, generous and magnanimous. He narrated from his noble fathers. Imam Ahmad reported from him in his Musnad (Hadith collection). Imam Tirmidhi reported hadiths from him in his book, “as-Sunan”, as did Qadhi Iyadh in his book, “al-Shifa”. He lived close to a hundred years. He passed away in Madinah in around 210 AH.

passages.sub: Imam Muhammad bin Ali al-Uraydhi
passages.ar: هو الإمام محمد بن علي العريضي، ولد بالمدينة ونشأ بها، وصحب أباه وتأدب به، ولم يزل تحت كنفه فلم يفارقه إلى أن انتقل والده إلى الدار الآخرة، ثم ارتحل إلى العراق وسكن بالبَصرة، وأحبه أهلها وأجلّوه لمكارم أخلاقه، وكان إمامًا عالمًا عاملًا جوادًا مجتهدًا في العبادة، مُلازمًا لطريق السادة الكُمّل، توفي بالبَصْرَة حدود سنة ٢٣٠هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm Muhammad bin `Alî al-`Uraidhî, wulida bil-Madînati wa nasya'a bihâ, wa shahiba abâhu wa ta'addaba bih, wa lam yazal tahta kanafihî falam yufâriqhu ilâ anintaqala wâliduhû ilad-dâril-âkhirah, tsummartahala ilal-`Irâqi wa sakana bil-Bashrah, wa ahabbahû ahluhâ wa ajallûhu limakârimi akhlâqih, wa kâna imâman `âliman `âmilan jawâdan mujtahidan fil-`ibâdah, mulâziman lithariqis-sâdatil-kummal, tuwuffiya bil-Bashrati hudûda sanati 230 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Muhammad bin ‘Ali al-‘Uraidhi. Beliau lahir dan besar di Madinah, menyertai ayahnya dan mengambil adab darinya, senantiasa berada di bawah naungannya dan tidak pernah berpisah darinya hingga sang ayah berpulang ke negeri akhirat. Setelah itu beliau berhijrah ke Irak dan menetap di Bashrah. Penduduknya mencintai dan memuliakan beliau karena akhlaknya yang mulia. Beliau adalah seorang imam yang alim, mengamalkan ilmunya, dermawan, bersungguh-sungguh dalam ibadah, dan senantiasa menapaki jalan para pemimpin yang sempurna. Beliau wafat di Bashrah sekitar tahun 230 H.
passages.en: Imam Muhammad, son of Ali al-Uraydhi, was born and raised in Madinah. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions. He remained by his side and did not leave him until his father passed on to the abode of the hereafter. He then traveled to Iraq and lived in Basrah. His noble character earned him the love and honor of the local populace. He was an Imam, a scholar, a devotee, generous, one who strove greatly in worship, and adhered to the path of the perfect masters. He passed away in Basrah in around 230 AH.

passages.sub: Imam Isa an-Naqib bin Muhammad
passages.ar: هو الإمام عيسى بن محمد بن علي العريضي، صحب والده وتأدب به، كانَ تقيًّا زكيًّا فصيحًا بليغًا، وكان ممّن تفنّن في العلوم، وفاقَ في أنواع الفضائل والفهوم، ولُقِّب بالنقيب لأنه كان نقيبًا على الأشراف، والنقيب هو ناظر القوم وضمينهم، وكانَ أبيض اللون وبياضه يميل إلى الحُمرة، وكانَ موطنهُ بالعراق، توفي بالبصرة حدود سنة ٢٧٠هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Îsâ bin Muhammad bin `Alî al-`Uraidhî, shahiba wâlidahû wa ta'addaba bih, kâna taqiyyan zakiyyan fashîhan balîghâ, wa kâna mimman tafannana fil-`ulûm, wa fâqa fî anwâ`il-fadhâ'ili wal-fuhûm, wa luqqiba bin-Naqîb li'annahû kâna naqîban `alal-asyrâf, wan-naqîbu huwa nâzhirul-qaumi wa dhamînuhum, wa kâna abyadhal-launi wa bayâdhuhû yamîlu ilal-humrah, wa kâna mauthinuhû bil-`Irâq, tuwuffiya bil-Bashrati hudûda sanati 270 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Isa bin Muhammad bin ‘Ali al-‘Uraidhi. Beliau menyertai ayahnya dan mengambil adab darinya. Beliau seorang yang bertakwa, suci, fasih, dan indah tutur katanya; termasuk orang yang menguasai beragam ilmu dan mengungguli yang lain dalam berbagai keutamaan dan pemahaman. Beliau dijuluki an-Naqib karena menjadi naqib para asyraf; naqib adalah pengawas dan penanggung jawab kaumnya. Kulit beliau putih kemerah-merahan, dan tempat tinggalnya di Irak. Beliau wafat di Bashrah sekitar tahun 270 H.
passages.en: Imam Isa bin Muhammad bin Ali al-Uraydhi grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions. He was mindful of Allah, pure, and very eloquent. He was of those who were experts in many fields of knowledge. He surpassed others in various virtues and in understanding. He was called ‘an-Naqib (the head)' because he was responsible for the descendants of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. He was reddish white. His home was in Iraq. He passed away in Basrah in around 270 AH.

passages.sub: Imam al-Muhajir ilaLlah Ahmad bin Isa
passages.ar: هو الإمام أحمد بن عيسى بن محمد بن علي العريضي، أبو السلالة الطيّبة الطّاهرة، وُلد بالبصرة في جمادى الأولى سنة ٢٧٣هـ وقيل ٢٦٠هـ ونشأ بها نشأة صالحة، كانَ عالمًا عاملًا ذو قلبٍ مُستنير وعلمٍ غزير، وكان له بالعراق جاه كبير ومال كثير لم يخطر على باله، بل كان مشتغلًا بالعبادة والإرشاد، تبعًا لأهله وسلفه الزُّهّاد، ولمّا رأى بنور البصيرة ما سيكون من فتن مثيرة في العراق.. هاجرَ منها بأهله ومن تعلّق به سنة ٣١٧هـ واستقرّ بحضرموت، وقام بنصرة السنة فيها، وتاب على يديه خلقٌ كثير، توفي سنة ٣٤٥هـ بالحُسيسة بحضرموت.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm Ahmad bin `Îsâ bin Muhammad bin `Alî al-`Uraidhî, abus-sulâlatith-thayyibatith-thâhirah, wulida bil-Bashrati fî Jumâdal-Ûlâ sanata 273 H wa qîla 260 H wa nasya'a bihâ nasy'atan shâlihah, kâna `âliman `âmilan dzû qalbin mustanîrin wa `ilmin ghazîr, wa kâna lahû bil-`Irâqi jâhun kabîrun wa mâlun katsîrun lam yakhthur `alâ bâlih, bal kâna musytaghilan bil-`ibâdati wal-irsyâd, taba`an li'ahlihî wa salafihiz-zuhhâd, wa lammâ ra'â binûril-bashîrati mâ sayakûnu min fitanin mutsîratin fil-`Irâq.. hâjara minhâ bi'ahlihî wa man ta`allaqa bihî sanata 317 H wastaqarra bi-Hadhramaut, wa qâma binushratis-sunnati fîhâ, wa tâba `alâ yadaihi khalqun katsîr, tuwuffiya sanata 345 H bil-Husaisati bi-Hadhramaut.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Ahmad bin ‘Isa bin Muhammad bin ‘Ali al-‘Uraidhi, bapak dari keturunan yang baik dan suci. Beliau lahir di Bashrah pada Jumadil Ula tahun 273 H (ada yang berpendapat 260 H) dan dibesarkan di sana dalam didikan yang shalih. Beliau adalah seorang alim yang mengamalkan ilmunya, berhati bercahaya, dan berilmu melimpah. Di Irak beliau memiliki kedudukan terpandang dan harta yang banyak, namun semua itu tidak pernah menyibukkan hatinya. Sebaliknya, beliau sibuk dengan ibadah dan bimbingan, mengikuti jejak keluarga dan para leluhurnya yang zuhud. Ketika dengan cahaya mata batinnya beliau melihat fitnah-fitnah dahsyat yang akan terjadi di Irak, beliau hijrah bersama keluarga dan orang-orang yang terikat dengannya pada tahun 317 H, lalu menetap di Hadhramaut. Di sana beliau menegakkan sunnah, dan banyak orang bertaubat di tangannya. Beliau wafat pada tahun 345 H di al-Husaisah, Hadhramaut.
passages.en: Imam Ahmad bin Isa bin Muhammad bin Ali al-Uraydhi is the father of the good and pure offspring. He was born in Basrah in Jumad al-Ula in 273 AH (886). Another opinion is that it was 260 AH. He had a righteous upbringing there. He was a scholar who acted on knowledge. He had an illuminated heart and copious knowledge. In Iraq, he had immense status and abundant wealth, yet neither of these things ever occupied his mind. Rather, he was busy with worship and providing guidance, following in the footsteps of his family and predecessors whose hearts were detached from the world. When he foresaw through inner sight the tribulations that would occur in Iraq, he migrated from there in 317 AH with his family and those who were attached to him. He settled in Hadhramaut, and gave victory to the Prophetic way there. Many people repented at his hands. He passed away in 345 AH (956) in al-Husayyisah in Hadhramaut.

passages.sub: Imam Ubaydullah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir
passages.ar: هو الإمام عبيد الله بن أحمد المهاجر، كانَ إمامًا جوادًا وحبرًا راسخًا، ولد بالبَصرة ونشأ بها، وتأدّب بأبيه وتخرّج عليه، وارتحل معه من العراق، وأخذ عن غيره من العلماء، واجتمعَ بمؤلف (قُوت القلوب) الإمام أبو طالب المكي، وقرأ عليه الكتاب المذكور أثناء رحلته للحج، وكانَ شديد التواضع لا يتسمّى بعبد الله بل يُصغّر اسمه ويقول عُبيد الله إجلالًا لربه واحتقارًا لنفسه، وهو الذي خلف أباهُ علمًا وزُهدًا وعبادة، وارتحل بعد وفاة والده إلى سُمَل وتوفي بها سنة ٣٨٣هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Ubaidullâh bin Ahmad al-Muhâjir, kâna imâman jawâdan wa habran râsikhâ, wulida bil-Bashrati wa nasya'a bihâ, wa ta'addaba bi'abîhi wa takharraja `alaih, wartahala ma`ahû minal-`Irâq, wa akhadza `an ghairihî minal-`ulamâ', wajtama`a bimu'allif (Qûtil-Qulûb) al-Imâm Abû Thâlib al-Makkî, wa qara'a `alaihil-kitâbal-madzkûra atsnâ'a rihlatihî lil-hajj, wa kâna syadîdat-tawâdhu`i lâ yatasammâ bi-`Abdillâh bal yushaghghiru-smahû wa yaqûlu `Ubaidullâh ijlâlan lirabbihî wahtiqâran linafsih, wa huwal-ladzî khalafa abâhu `ilman wa zuhdan wa `ibâdah, wartahala ba`da wafâti wâlidihî ilâ Sumal wa tuwuffiya bihâ sanata 383 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Ubaidillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir, seorang imam yang dermawan dan ulama besar yang mendalam ilmunya. Lahir dan besar di Bashrah, beliau mengambil adab dari ayahnya dan lulus dari didikannya, ikut hijrah bersamanya dari Irak, dan belajar pula dari ulama lainnya. Beliau bertemu dengan penulis kitab Qut al-Qulub, al-Imam Abu Thalib al-Makki, dan membacakan kitab tersebut langsung kepadanya saat perjalanan haji. Beliau sangat rendah hati: tidak mau menamakan dirinya ‘Abdullah, melainkan mengecilkan namanya menjadi ‘Ubaidillah (hamba kecil Allah), sebagai pengagungan kepada Tuhannya dan perendahan dirinya. Beliaulah yang mewarisi ayahnya dalam ilmu, zuhud, dan ibadah. Setelah ayahnya wafat beliau pindah ke Sumal dan wafat di sana pada tahun 383 H.
passages.en: Imam Ubaydillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir was a generous Imam, a sage and firmly rooted in knowledge. He was born and raised in Basrah. He imitated his father in all his states and actions, and was educated by him. He migrated with him from Iraq and took from other scholars. He met with the author of “Qut al-Qulub”, Imam Abu Talib al-Makki, and read his book to him during his journey for Hajj. He was extremely humble. He would not call himself Abdullah (slave of Allah), but rather use Ubayd, which is the diminutive form of Abd (slave) and say Ubaydullah (the small slave of Allah) in reverence of his Lord, looking down on himself. He succeeded his father in knowledge, detachment from the world and worship. After his father passed away he moved to Sumal, where he passed away in 383 AH.

passages.sub: Imam Alawi bin Ubaydillah
passages.ar: هو الإمام علوي بن عبيد الله بن أحمد المهاجر، ولد بحضرموت ونشأ بها، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، واشتغلَ بطلب العلوم وتأدب بأبيه، وهو أول من سُمّي علوي، وجميع آل باعلوي ينتسبون إليه، وكانَ كثير القيام والصيام، كثير المجاهدة والرياضة مع الورعِ التام، وكان كثير التصدّق والإحسان في السر والإعلان، وحج بيت الله الحرام وعزم معه ثمانون رَجُلًا غير حاشيته وحشمه، فكان ينفق على الجميع مدة سفرهم إلى رجوعهم، توفي بـ(سُمل).
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alawî bin `Ubaidillâh bin Ahmad al-Muhâjir, wulida bi-Hadhramauta wa nasya'a bihâ, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wasytaghala bithalabil-`ulûmi wa ta'addaba bi'abîh, wa huwa awwalu man summiya `Alawî, wa jamî`u âli Bâ`alawî yantasibûna ilaih, wa kâna katsîral-qiyâmi wash-shiyâm, katsîral-mujâhadati war-riyâdhati ma`al-wara`it-tâmm, wa kâna katsîrat-tashadduqi wal-ihsâni fis-sirri wal-i`lân, wa hajja baitallâhil-harâma wa `azama ma`ahû tsamânûna rajulan ghaira hâsyiyatihî wa hasyamih, fakâna yunfiqu `alal-jamî`i muddata safarihim ilâ rujû`ihim, tuwuffiya bi-(Sumal).
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Alawi bin ‘Ubaidillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir. Beliau lahir dan besar di Hadhramaut, menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, tekun mencari ilmu, dan mengambil adab dari ayahnya. Beliau adalah orang pertama yang dinamai ‘Alawi, dan seluruh keluarga Ba ‘Alawi bernasab kepadanya. Beliau banyak melakukan shalat malam dan puasa, banyak bermujahadah dan beriyadhah dengan sifat wara‘ yang sempurna, serta banyak bersedekah dan berbuat baik secara sembunyi-sembunyi maupun terang-terangan. Ketika berhaji ke Baitullah, delapan puluh orang laki-laki ikut berangkat bersamanya, belum termasuk keluarga dan para pembantunya, dan beliau menanggung nafkah mereka semua selama perjalanan hingga kembali. Beliau wafat di Sumal.
passages.en: Imam Alawi bin Ubaydillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir was born and raised in Hadramawt. He memorized the Glorious Quran, engaged in seeking knowledge, and imitated his father in all his states and actions. He is the first to be given the name Alawi. The entire Ba Alawi family traces back to him. He would engage in abundant night worship, fasting and spiritual striving with total scrupulousness. He would give abundant charity and do many benevolent acts, secretly and openly. He performed Hajj of Allah's sacred House, and in addition to his retinue and entourage, there were eighty other men who traveled with him. He spent on all of them for the duration of their journey until they returned. He passed away in Sumal.

passages.sub: Imam Muhammad Sahib as-Sawma'ah bin Alawi
passages.ar: هو الإمام محمد بن علوي بن عبيدالله بن أحمد المهاجر، ولد ببَيت جُبِير ونشأ بها، وحفظ القرآن العظيم وغيره من الكتب، واجتهد في الطلب، وصحب أباه ومن في زمنه من العلماء، وجمعَ الله له بين فصاحة اللسان، وبلاغة البيان، وصلاح المقال، وكان ورعًا في جميع أموره فلا يستعمل إلا ما تحقق حِلّه، توفي بها، وعمره ٥٦ سنة.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm Muhammad bin `Alawî bin `Ubaidillâh bin Ahmad al-Muhâjir, wulida bi-Baiti Jubair wa nasya'a bihâ, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîma wa ghairahû minal-kutub, wajtahada fith-thalab, wa shahiba abâhu wa man fî zamanihî minal-`ulamâ', wa jama`allâhu lahû baina fashâhatil-lisân, wa balâghatil-bayân, wa shalâhil-maqâl, wa kâna wari`an fî jamî`i umûrihî falâ yasta`milu illâ mâ tahaqqaqa hilluh, tuwuffiya bihâ, wa `umruhû 56 sanah.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Muhammad bin ‘Alawi bin ‘Ubaidillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir. Lahir dan besar di Bait Jubair, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan kitab-kitab lainnya, bersungguh-sungguh dalam menuntut ilmu, serta menyertai ayahnya dan para ulama pada zamannya. Allah menghimpun untuknya kefasihan lisan, keindahan penjelasan, dan kebaikan tutur kata. Beliau sangat wara‘ dalam segala urusannya sehingga tidak memakai sesuatu kecuali yang sudah pasti kehalalannya. Beliau wafat di sana pada usia 56 tahun.
passages.en: Imam Muhammad bin Alawi bin Ubaydillah bin Ahmad al-Muhajir was born and raised in Bayt Jubayr. He memorized the Glorious Quran and other books. He strove to seek knowledge. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father and other scholars of his time. Allah granted him both an eloquent tongue and righteous speech. He was scrupulous in all matters and would only use what was proven to be lawful. He passed away in Bayt Jubayr at the age of 56.

passages.sub: Imam Alawi bin Muhammad Sahib as-Sawma'ah
passages.ar: هو الإمام علوي بن محمد بن علوي بن عبيدالله، ولد ببيت جُبير ونشأ بها، وصحب أباه ولم تُعرف له صبوة من صِباه، وكان من العلماء العاملين، جوادًا سخيًّا ذا رأفةٍ ورحمةٍ بالمسلمين، وعمل بآداب الشريعة، توفي ببيت جُبير سنة ٥١٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alawî bin Muhammad bin `Alawî bin `Ubaidillâh, wulida bi-Baiti Jubair wa nasya'a bihâ, wa shahiba abâhu wa lam tu`raf lahû shabwatun min shibâh, wa kâna minal-`ulamâ'il-`âmilîn, jawâdan sakhiyyan dzâ ra'fatin wa rahmatin bil-muslimîn, wa `amila bi'âdâbisy-syarî`ah, tuwuffiya bi-Baiti Jubair sanata 512 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Alawi bin Muhammad bin ‘Alawi bin ‘Ubaidillah. Lahir dan besar di Bait Jubair, beliau menyertai ayahnya dan sejak kecil tidak pernah dikenal condong pada kesenangan masa muda. Beliau termasuk ulama yang mengamalkan ilmunya, dermawan, murah hati, penuh kasih dan sayang kepada kaum muslimin, serta beramal dengan adab-adab syariat. Beliau wafat di Bait Jubair pada tahun 512 H.
passages.en: Imam Alawi bin Muhammad bin Alawi bin Ubaydillah was born and raised in Bayt Jubayr. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father and was never known to have been inclined to childish desires from infancy. He was of the scholars who act on their knowledge. He was generous and magnanimous, and full of compassion and mercy for the Muslims. He acted according to the etiquette of the Sacred Law. He passed away in Bayt Jubayr in 512 AH.

passages.sub: Imam Ali Khali' Qasam
passages.ar:
هو الإمام علي خالع قسم بن علوي بن محمد باعلوي، ولد ببيت جُبير ونشأ بها، وصحب أباه وأخذ عنه، وانتقل إلى تريم سنة ٥٢١هـ، اشترى أرضًا وسماها قَسَم وغرسها نخلًا، وبنى بها دارًا هو وغيره حتى صارت قرية قَسم؛ فلُقِّب بخالع قسم، وكان ممّن خصّه الله وحباهُ بالولاية والسّر، وكانَ إذا قالَ في الصلاة أو غيرها:
"السلامُ عليك أيها النبي ورحمة اللهِ وبركاته"
يكرّرها حتّى يسمعَ الرّد من الحضرةِ النّبويّة يقول له:
"وعليكَ السلامُ يا شيخ ورحمة اللهِ وبركاته"
ويسمعُ الصوت الذين خلفه، توفي بتريم سنة ٥٢٢هـ، ودُفن بزنبل وهو أول من دُفن فيها من السادة العلويّين.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alî Khâli` Qasam bin `Alawî bin Muhammad Bâ`alawî, wulida bi-Baiti Jubair wa nasya'a bihâ, wa shahiba abâhu wa akhadza `anh, wantaqala ilâ Tarîm sanata 521 H, isytarâ ardhan wa sammâhâ Qasam wa gharasahâ nakhlâ, wa banâ bihâ dâran huwa wa ghairuhû hattâ shârat qaryata Qasam; faluqqiba bi-Khâli` Qasam, wa kâna mimman khashshahullâhu wa habâhu bil-wilâyati was-sirr, wa kâna idzâ qâla fish-shalâti au ghairihâ: "as-salâmu `alaika ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh" yukarriruhâ hattâ yasma`ar-radda minal-hadhratin-nabawiyyati yaqûlu lah: "wa `alaikas-salâmu yâ syaikh wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh" wa yasma`ush-shautal-ladzîna khalfah, tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm sanata 522 H, wa dufina bi-Zanbal wa huwa awwalu man dufina fîhâ minas-sâdatil-`alawiyyîn.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Ali Khali‘ Qasam bin ‘Alawi bin Muhammad Ba ‘Alawi. Lahir dan besar di Bait Jubair, beliau menyertai ayahnya dan mengambil ilmu darinya. Beliau pindah ke Tarim pada tahun 521 H, membeli sebidang tanah yang dinamainya Qasam dan menanaminya dengan pohon kurma, lalu membangun rumah di sana bersama yang lain hingga menjadi desa Qasam; karena itulah beliau dijuluki Khali‘ Qasam. Beliau termasuk orang yang Allah istimewakan dan karuniai kewalian dan rahasia ilahi. Setiap kali beliau mengucapkan dalam shalat atau di luarnya, “As-salamu ‘alaika ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh,” beliau mengulang-ulangnya hingga mendengar jawaban dari hadirat Nabi ﷺ, “Wa ‘alaikas-salam ya syaikh wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh,” dan orang-orang di belakang beliau pun mendengar suara itu. Beliau wafat di Tarim pada tahun 522 H dan dimakamkan di Zanbal; beliau adalah orang pertama dari para sadah ‘Alawiyyin yang dimakamkan di sana.
passages.en: Imam Ali Khali' Qasam bin Alawi bin Muhammad Ba Alawi was born and raised in Bayt Jubayr. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father and took from him. He moved to Tarim in 521 AH. He bought land and named it Qasam and planted date palms. He built a house there, as did others, eventually turning the area into the village of Qasam. He was thus known as Khali' Qasam or “he who planted Qasam”. He was of those whom Allah distinguished with sainthood and spiritual secrets. Whenever he said in salah or outside salah, “as-Salamu alayka ayyuhan Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings)”, he would repeat it until he heard the response from the Prophetic presence saying to him, “wa alaykas Salam ya Shaykh wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (and upon you be peace, O Shaykh, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings)”. Those behind him would hear the voice too. He passed away in Tarim in 522 AH. He is the first of the Alawi masters to be buried in the Zanbal cemetery.

passages.sub: Imam Muhammad Sahib Mirbat
passages.ar: هو الإمام محمد صاحب مرباط بن علي خالع قسم، ولد بتريم وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وتأدب بأبيه ولازمه وألبسه خرقة التصوف، وجدّ في طلب العلم، وكان إمامًا راسخًا جوادًا ماجدًا، وكانت له صدقات كبيرة سرًّا وجهرا، وكانَ لهُ الهيبة العظيمة عند الملوك وغيرهم، أخذَ العلمَ عنه كثير، منهم: أولاده علوي وعبد الله وأحمد وعلي (والد الفقيه)، والشيخ سعيد الظّفاري والشيخ سالم بافضل والشيخ علي بامروان وغيرهم، توفي بمرباط سنة ٥٥٦هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm Muhammad Shâhib Mirbâth bin `Alî Khâli` Qasam, wulida bi-Tarîm wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa ta'addaba bi'abîhi wa lâzamahû wa albasahû khirqatat-tashawwuf, wa jadda fî thalabil-`ilm, wa kâna imâman râsikhan jawâdan mâjidâ, wa kânat lahû shadaqâtun kabîratun sirran wa jahrâ, wa kâna lahul-haibatul-`azhîmatu `indal-mulûki wa ghairihim, akhadzal-`ilma `anhu katsîr, minhum: aulâduhû `Alawî wa `Abdullâh wa Ahmad wa `Alî (wâlidul-Faqîh), wasy-Syaikh Sa`îd azh-Zhafârî wasy-Syaikh Sâlim Bâfadhl wasy-Syaikh `Alî Bâmarwân wa ghairuhum, tuwuffiya bi-Mirbâth sanata 556 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Muhammad Shahib Mirbath bin ‘Ali Khali‘ Qasam. Beliau lahir di Tarim, menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, tumbuh besar di sana, mengambil adab dari ayahnya, terus mendampinginya, dan menerima khirqah tasawuf darinya. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh dalam menuntut ilmu; seorang imam yang kokoh ilmunya, dermawan, dan luhur budinya. Beliau memiliki sedekah-sedekah yang besar, secara diam-diam maupun terang-terangan, serta wibawa yang agung di hadapan para raja dan selainnya. Banyak yang mengambil ilmu darinya, antara lain putra-putra beliau: ‘Alawi, ‘Abdullah, Ahmad, dan ‘Ali (ayah al-Faqih), serta Syaikh Sa‘id azh-Zhafari, Syaikh Salim Bafadhal, Syaikh ‘Ali Bamarwan, dan lain-lain. Beliau wafat di Mirbath pada tahun 556 H.
passages.en: Imam Muhammad Sahib Mirbat bin Ali Khali' Qasam was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran, and imitated his father in all his states and actions, and adhered to him. His father invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah) of Sufism. He made every effort in seeking knowledge. He was an Imam who was firmly rooted in knowledge. He was generous and honorable. He would give great charity secretly and openly. He was held in immense awe by kings and others. Many took knowledge from him, including his children, Alawi, Abdullah, Ahmad and Ali (the father of al-Faqih), as well as Shaykh Saeed al-Dhafari, Shaykh Salim Ba Fadhl, Shaykh Ali Ba Marwan, and others. He passed away in Mirbat in 556 AH (1160).

passages.sub: Imam Alawi, the uncle of al-Faqih al-Muqaddam
passages.ar: هو الإمام علوي بن محمد صاحب مرباط، ولد بتريم ونشأ بها، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، صحب أباه وألبسه خرقة التصوف، وأخذ عن الشيخ سالم بافضل والسيد سالم بن بصري وغيرهم، كان علَمًا يُهتدى به ومحبوبًا عند الناس، وكان ملازما للآداب الشرعية والسنن النبوية، وكان حسن الأخلاق كريمًا كثير التبسُّم، توفي يوم الاثنين ٤ ذو القعدة سنة ٦١٣هـ ودُفن بزنبل، خلّف أربعة أولاد فقهاء وهم: أحمد وعبد الله وعبد الرحمن وعبد الملك.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alawî bin Muhammad Shâhib Mirbâth, wulida bi-Tarîm wa nasya'a bihâ, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, shahiba abâhu wa albasahû khirqatat-tashawwuf, wa akhadza `anisy-Syaikh Sâlim Bâfadhl was-Sayyid Sâlim bin Bashrî wa ghairihim, kâna `alaman yuhtadâ bihî wa mahbûban `indan-nâs, wa kâna mulâziman lil-âdâbisy-syar`iyyati was-sunanin-nabawiyyah, wa kâna hasanal-akhlâqi karîman katsîrat-tabassum, tuwuffiya yaumal-itsnain 4 Dzil-Qa`dah sanata 613 H wa dufina bi-Zanbal, khallafa arba`ata aulâdin fuqahâ'a wa hum: Ahmad wa `Abdullâh wa `Abdurrahmân wa `Abdul-Malik.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Alawi bin Muhammad Shahib Mirbath. Lahir dan besar di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, menyertai ayahnya, dan menerima khirqah tasawuf darinya. Beliau juga belajar dari Syaikh Salim Bafadhal, Sayyid Salim bin Bashri, dan ulama lainnya. Beliau adalah panutan yang menjadi petunjuk dan dicintai masyarakat, teguh memegang adab-adab syariat dan sunnah-sunnah Nabi, berakhlak baik, dermawan, dan murah senyum. Beliau wafat pada hari Senin, 4 Dzulqa‘dah 613 H, dan dimakamkan di Zanbal. Beliau meninggalkan empat putra yang menjadi ahli fikih: Ahmad, ‘Abdullah, ‘Abdurrahman, dan ‘Abdul Malik.
passages.en: Imam Alawi bin Muhammad Sahib Mirbat was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran, and grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah) of Sufism. He took from Shaykh Salim Ba Fadhl, Sayyid Salim bin Basri and others. He was a beacon of guidance, and loved by people. He adhered to the etiquettes of the Sacred Law and the Prophetic sunnahs. He had beautiful character, was generous, and smiled a lot. He passed away on Monday, 4th Dhul Qa'dah, 613 AH (1217), and was buried in Zanbal. He left behind four sons who were jurists: Ahmad, Abdullah, Abdur Rahman and Abdul Malik.

passages.sub: Imam Ali bin Muhammad, the father of al-Faqih
passages.ar: هو الإمام علي بن محمد صاحب مرباط، ولد بتريم ونشأ بها، صحب أباه وألبسه خرقة التصوف، وتفقّه في الدين على كثير من العلماء، وكان ذا سيرة حسنة، وكان شيخًا عالمًا زاهدًا تقيًّا صوفيًا صاحب سرائر عظيمة وأخلاق مُرضية، ويكفيه خروج الفقيه المُقدّم من صُلبه، ولمْ تطُل حياته، توفي سنة نيف وسبعين وخمسمائة هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alî bin Muhammad Shâhib Mirbâth, wulida bi-Tarîm wa nasya'a bihâ, shahiba abâhu wa albasahû khirqatat-tashawwuf, wa tafaqqaha fid-dîni `alâ katsîrin minal-`ulamâ', wa kâna dzâ sîratin hasanah, wa kâna syaikhan `âliman zâhidan taqiyyan shûfiyyan shâhiba sarâ'ira `azhîmatin wa akhlâqin murdhiyah, wa yakfîhi khurûjul-Faqîhil-Muqaddami min shulbih, wa lam tathul hayâtuh, tuwuffiya sanata naifin wa sab`îna wa khamsimi'ah H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Ali bin Muhammad Shahib Mirbath. Lahir dan besar di Tarim, beliau menyertai ayahnya dan menerima khirqah tasawuf darinya. Beliau mendalami agama dari banyak ulama, memiliki perjalanan hidup yang baik, dan dikenal sebagai seorang syaikh yang alim, zahid, bertakwa, dan sufi, pemilik rahasia-rahasia ilahi yang agung dan akhlak yang diridhai. Cukuplah sebagai kemuliaan baginya bahwa al-Faqih al-Muqaddam lahir dari sulbinya. Beliau tidak berumur panjang dan wafat pada tahun tujuh puluhan lebih setelah lima ratus Hijriah.
passages.en: Imam Ali bin Muhammad Sahib Mirbat was born and raised in Tarim. He grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah) of Sufism. He studied the religion from many scholars. He had beautiful conduct. He was a Shaykh, a scholar, a Sufi, was detached from the world, pious, had a great soul and pleasant character. That al-Faqih al-Muqaddam came from his loins is sufficient. He did not live long. He passed away between 571 and 579 AH.

passages.sub: Imam Muhammad bin Ali (al-Faqih al-Muqaddam)
passages.ar:
هو الأستاذ الأعظم الفقيه المُقدّم محمد بن علي باعلوي، وُلد بتريم سنة ٥٧٤هـ ونشأ بها وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ولاحظتهُ العناية من صِغره، وأخذَ عن عُلماء عصره حتّى فاقَ الأقران، منهم: الشيخ عبد الله باعبيد والقاضي أحمد باعيسى والإمام علي بامروان، والحافظ علي بن جديد، وأخذ التصوف عن الإمام سالم بن بصري والشيخ محمد الخطيب وعن عمه الشيخ علوي بن محمد صاحب مرباط، وأخذ الطريقة بالواسطة عن الشيخ العارف بالله شُعيب أبو مَدْيَن، وكانَ عظيم المجاهدات في العمل بالشريعة والتخلّق بمحاسن الأخلاق، وكان مُتقيّدًا في جميع حركاته بالكتابِ والسنّة، قال فيه الشيخ عبد الرحمن السقاف:
"ما نفضل على الفقيه أحد إلا الصحابة أو من ورد في فضلهِ نص كأُوَيْس القَرَني" تخرّج عليه كثيرٌ من العلماء والأولياء، منهم: أولاده الصُلحاء علوي وعبد الله وأحمد وعبد الرحمن وعلي، والشيخ عبد الله باعبّاد والشيخ عبد الله باقشير، له كرامات كبيرة وأحوال عظيمة لا تُحد ولا تُحصى، توفي بتريم ليلة الأحد آخر شهر ذي الحجة سنة ٦٥٣هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Ustâdzul-A`zham al-Faqîhul-Muqaddam Muhammad bin `Alî Bâ`alawî, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 574 H wa nasya'a bihâ wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa lâhazhat-hul-`inâyatu min shighrih, wa akhadza `an `ulamâ'i `ashrihî hattâ fâqal-aqrân, minhum: asy-Syaikh `Abdullâh Bâ`ubaid wal-Qâdhî Ahmad Bâ`îsâ wal-Imâm `Alî Bâmarwân, wal-hâfizh `Alî bin Jadîd, wa akhadzat-tashawwufa `anil-Imâm Sâlim bin Bashrî wasy-Syaikh Muhammad al-Khathîb wa `an `ammihisy-Syaikh `Alawî bin Muhammad Shâhib Mirbâth, wa akhadzath-tharîqata bil-wâsithati `anisy-Syaikhil-`ârifi billâh Syu`aib Abû Madyan, wa kâna `azhîmal-mujâhadâti fil-`amali bisy-syarî`ati wat-takhalluqi bimahâsinil-akhlâq, wa kâna mutaqayyidan fî jamî`i harakâtihî bil-Kitâbi was-Sunnah, qâla fîhisy-Syaikh `Abdurrahmân as-Saqqâf: "mâ nufadhdhilu `alal-Faqîhi ahad illash-shahâbata au man warada fî fadhlihî nashshun ka'Uwaisinil-Qaranî" takharraja `alaihi katsîrun minal-`ulamâ'i wal-auliyâ', minhum: aulâduhush-shulahâ'u `Alawî wa `Abdullâh wa Ahmad wa `Abdurrahmân wa `Alî, wasy-Syaikh `Abdullâh Bâ`abbâd wasy-Syaikh `Abdullâh Bâqusyair, lahû karâmâtun kabîratun wa ahwâlun `azhîmatun lâ tuhaddu wa lâ tuhshâ, tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm lailatal-ahadi âkhira syahri Dzil-Hijjah sanata 653 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah guru besar, al-Ustadz al-A‘zham al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin ‘Ali Ba ‘Alawi. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 574 H dan tumbuh besar di sana, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, dan penjagaan ilahi telah menaunginya sejak kecil. Beliau belajar dari para ulama di zamannya hingga melampaui rekan-rekannya; di antara gurunya adalah Syaikh ‘Abdullah Ba ‘Ubaid, Qadhi Ahmad Ba ‘Isa, al-Imam ‘Ali Bamarwan, dan al-Hafizh ‘Ali bin Jadid. Beliau mengambil tasawuf dari al-Imam Salim bin Bashri, Syaikh Muhammad al-Khathib, dan pamannya sendiri, Syaikh ‘Alawi bin Muhammad Shahib Mirbath, serta mengambil thariqah melalui perantara dari Syaikh al-‘Arif billah Syu‘aib Abu Madyan. Beliau sangat gigih bermujahadah dalam mengamalkan syariat dan berhias dengan akhlak yang mulia, dan seluruh gerak-geriknya terikat pada Al-Qur'an dan Sunnah. Syaikh ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf berkata tentangnya, “Kami tidak mengutamakan siapa pun di atas al-Faqih, kecuali para sahabat atau mereka yang keutamaannya disebut dalam nash, seperti Uwais al-Qarni.” Banyak ulama dan wali yang lulus dari didikannya, di antaranya putra-putra shalihnya — ‘Alawi, ‘Abdullah, Ahmad, ‘Abdurrahman, dan ‘Ali — serta Syaikh ‘Abdullah Ba ‘Abbad dan Syaikh ‘Abdullah Ba Qusyair. Beliau memiliki karamah-karamah besar dan hal-hal spiritual agung yang tak terhitung jumlahnya. Beliau wafat di Tarim pada malam Ahad, akhir bulan Dzulhijjah, tahun 653 H.
passages.en: Al-Ustadh al-A'dham (the greatest master) al-Faqih al-Muqaddam (the foremost jurist) Muhammad bin Ali Ba Alawi was born in Tarim in 574 AH (1178) and raised there. He memorized the Glorious Quran. Divine providence watched over him from childhood. He took from the scholars of his time and surpassed his peers. Among those he took from were: Shaykh Abdullah Ba Ubayd, Qadhi Ahmad Ba Isa, Imam Ali Ba Marwan and al-Hafidh Ali bin Jadid. He took Sufism from Imam Salim bin Basri, Shaykh Muhammad al-Khatib, and his uncle Shaykh Alawi bin Muhammad Sahib Mirbat. He took the path through a mediary from the Shaykh and Knower of Allah Shuayb Abu Madyan. He strove immensely to act on the Sacred Law and have beautiful character. In all of his movements, he was bound to the Book and the Sunnah. Shaykh Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf said about him, “I do not give any of the awliya' precedence over al-Faqih other than the Companions or someone whose merit was mentioned by the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) such as Uways al-Qarani.” Many scholars and saints were educated by him, including his righteous children Alawi, Abdullah, Ahmad, Abdur Rahman and Ali, and Shaykh Abdullah Ba Abbad and Shaykh Abdullah Ba Qushayr. He had innumerable great miracles and immense spiritual states. He passed away in Tarim on Saturday night at the end of Dhul Hijjah in 653 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Alawi ibn al-Faqih
passages.ar: هو الإمام علوي بن الفقيه المقدم محمد بن علي باعلوي، عُرِفَ بالغَيُور، وُلد بتريم وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وصحِب أباه وتأدّب به وألبسه خرقة التصوف، وكان والده يُثني عليه ويُشيرُ بأنه صاحب الولاية العُظمى، وقدْ أشارَ المشايخ بأنّ سرّ والده انتقلَ إليه، وكانَ رحمهُ الله يسمعُ تسبيح الجمادات، وكان مما وهبه مولاه يعرف الشّقي من السّعيد، توفي يوم الجمعة ثاني ذي القعدة سنة ٦٦٩هـ وقبرهُ بزنبل خلّفَ ولدين: علي وعبد الله (باعلوي).
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alawî bin al-Faqîhil-Muqaddam Muhammad bin `Alî Bâ`alawî, `urifa bil-Ghayûr, wulida bi-Tarîm wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa shahiba abâhu wa ta'addaba bihî wa albasahû khirqatat-tashawwuf, wa kâna wâliduhû yutsnî `alaihi wa yusyîru bi'annahû shâhibul-wilâyatil-`uzhmâ, wa qad asyâral-masyâyikhu bi'anna sirra wâlidihintaqala ilaih, wa kâna rahimahullâhu yasma`u tasbîhal-jamâdât, wa kâna mimmâ wahabahû maulâhu ya`rifusy-syaqiyya minas-sa`îd, tuwuffiya yaumal-jum`ati tsâniya Dzil-Qa`dah sanata 669 H wa qabruhû bi-Zanbal, khallafa waladain: `Alî wa `Abdullâh (Bâ`alawî).
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Alawi bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin ‘Ali Ba ‘Alawi, yang dikenal dengan julukan al-Ghayur. Lahir di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, tumbuh besar di sana, menyertai ayahnya, mengambil adab darinya, dan menerima khirqah tasawuf darinya. Ayahnya sering memujinya dan mengisyaratkan bahwa ia adalah pemilik kewalian yang agung; para masyayikh pun mengisyaratkan bahwa rahasia spiritual ayahnya berpindah kepadanya. Beliau — semoga Allah merahmatinya — dapat mendengar tasbih benda-benda mati, dan di antara anugerah Tuhannya kepadanya adalah kemampuan mengenali siapa yang celaka dan siapa yang bahagia. Beliau wafat pada hari Jumat, 2 Dzulqa‘dah 669 H; makamnya di Zanbal. Beliau meninggalkan dua putra: ‘Ali dan ‘Abdullah (Ba ‘Alawi).
passages.en: Imam Alawi bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam Muhammad bin Ali Ba Alawi was known as al-Ghayur. He was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran, and grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions. His father invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah) of Sufism. His father would praise him and allude to him having the greatest sainthood. The Shaykhs have alluded to the spiritual secret of his father being passed down to him. He (may Allah have mercy on him) would hear the glorification (tasbih) of inanimate objects. Among the gifts Allah bestowed upon him was the ability to distinguish between the wretched and the felicitous. He passed away on Friday, the 2nd of Dhul Qa'dhah in 669 AH (1271). His grave is in Zanbal. He left behind two sons: Ali and Abdullah (Ba Alawi).

passages.sub: Shaykh Ali bin Alawi ibn al-Faqih
passages.ar:
هو الإمام علي بن علوي بن محمد الفقيه المقدّم، ولد بتريم وحفظ القرآن العظيم، صَحِب أباه وتأدّب به ولحق جده الفقيه في حال صِغره ففاضتْ عليه نفحاتهما، وكان مُجاب الدعاء، وكان من الأولياء العارفين، صاحب مجاهدات ورياضات وخلوات، قال محمد بن مسعود:
(جاءهُ شيءٌ من الدنيا، فسمعتهُ يقول: علي بن علوي ودنيا!! اللَّهُمَّ انقلني عنها، أو انقلها عنّي، فمات بعد ذلك بشهرين أو ثلاثة) توفي بتريم ليلة الأربعاء ١٩ رجب سنة ٧٠٩هـ، وقبرهُ بزنبل.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm `Alî bin `Alawî bin Muhammad al-Faqîhil-Muqaddam, wulida bi-Tarîm wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, shahiba abâhu wa ta'addaba bihî wa lahiqa jaddahul-Faqîha fî hâli shighrihî fafâdhat `alaihi nafahâtuhumâ, wa kâna mujâbad-da`wah, wa kâna minal-auliyâ'il-`ârifîn, shâhiba mujâhadâtin wa riyâdhâtin wa khalawât, qâla Muhammad bin Mas`ûd: (jâ'ahû syai'un minad-dunyâ, fasami`tuhû yaqûl: `Alî bin `Alawî wa dunyâ!! Allâhummanqulnî `anhâ, awinqulhâ `annî, famâta ba`da dzâlika bisyahraini au tsalâtsah) tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm lailatal-arbi`â' 19 Rajab sanata 709 H, wa qabruhû bi-Zanbal.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam ‘Ali bin ‘Alawi bin Muhammad al-Faqih al-Muqaddam. Lahir di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, menyertai ayahnya dan mengambil adab darinya, serta sempat menjumpai kakeknya, al-Faqih, di masa kecil, sehingga limpahan anugerah spiritual keduanya tercurah kepadanya. Beliau seorang yang mustajab doanya, termasuk para wali yang arif, pemilik mujahadah, riyadhah, dan khalwat. Muhammad bin Mas‘ud berkata, “Sesuatu dari dunia datang kepadanya, lalu aku mendengar beliau berkata, ‘Ali bin ‘Alawi dan dunia?! Ya Allah, pindahkanlah aku darinya atau pindahkanlah ia dariku.' Dua atau tiga bulan setelah itu beliau pun wafat.” Beliau wafat di Tarim pada malam Rabu, 19 Rajab 709 H, dan makamnya di Zanbal.
passages.en: Imam Ali bin Alawi bin Muhammad al-Faqih al-Muqaddam was born in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran, and grew up under the watchful eye of his father, who he came to imitate in all his states and actions. He was able to keep close to his grandfather, al-Faqih, when he was a child. As a result, the spiritual gifts of his grandfather and father poured down upon him. His prayers would be answered. He was one of the saints and knowers of Allah. He would strive greatly in spiritual exercises and solitary retreats. Muhammad bin Masud said, “Something of this world came to him, so I heard him say, ‘Ali bin Alawi and the lower world!! O Allah, move me away from it or move it away from me.' He passed away two or three months later.” He passed away in Tarim on Tuesday night, the 19th Rajab in 709 AH. His grave is in Zanbal.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abdullah bin Alawi bin al-Faqih
passages.ar:
هو الشيخ الإمام عبد الله بن علوي بن الفقيه المقدم، ولد سنة ٦٣٨ أو ٦٤٠هـ بتريم ونشأ بها وحفظ القرآن العظيم، أدرك جده الفقيه في زمن صباه، وأخذ عن والده الذي ربّاه، وطلب العلم حتى فاقَ الأقران، وأخذ عن الفقيه أحمد بن عبد الرحمن بن علوي والشيخ إبراهيم باقشير، وكانَ له المجاهدات العظيمة، قال الشيخ عبد الرحمن السقاف:
"اتفق أهل زماننا أن الشيخ عبد الله بن علوي بقية المجتهدين"، وجاورَ بمكة ثمان سنين، وصحب علماءها وصلحاءها، واستسقى به أهلها مرتين فسُقوا، وعاد إلى تريم بعد وفاة أخيه علي، وكان كثير الإنفاق والصدقة، تصدّق على مسجد باعلوي بما قيمته ٩٠ ألف دينار، توفي بتريم يوم الأربعاء للنصف من جمادى الأولى سنة ٧٣١هـ.
passages.tr: Huwasy-Syaikhul-Imâm `Abdullâh bin `Alawî bin al-Faqîhil-Muqaddam, wulida sanata 638 au 640 H bi-Tarîm wa nasya'a bihâ wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, adraka jaddahul-Faqîha fî zamani shibâh, wa akhadza `an wâlidihil-ladzî rabbâh, wa thalabal-`ilma hattâ fâqal-aqrân, wa akhadza `anil-Faqîh Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân bin `Alawî wasy-Syaikh Ibrâhîm Bâqusyair, wa kâna lahul-mujâhadâtul-`azhîmah, qâlasy-Syaikh `Abdurrahmân as-Saqqâf: "ittafaqa ahlu zamâninâ annasy-Syaikh `Abdallâh bin `Alawî baqiyyatul-mujtahidîn", wa jâwara bi-Makkata tsamâna sinîn, wa shahiba `ulamâ'ahâ wa shulahâ'ahâ, wastasqâ bihî ahluhâ marrataini fasuqû, wa `âda ilâ Tarîm ba`da wafâti akhîhi `Alî, wa kâna katsîral-infâqi wash-shadaqah, tashaddaqa `alâ masjidi Bâ`alawî bimâ qîmatuhû 90 alfa dînâr, tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm yaumal-arbi`â'i lin-nishfi min Jumâdal-Ûlâ sanata 731 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah asy-Syaikh al-Imam ‘Abdullah bin ‘Alawi bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 638 atau 640 H dan tumbuh besar di sana, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung. Beliau sempat menjumpai kakeknya, al-Faqih, di masa kecil, mengambil ilmu dari ayahnya yang mendidiknya, dan menuntut ilmu hingga melampaui rekan-rekannya. Di antara gurunya adalah al-Faqih Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman bin ‘Alawi dan Syaikh Ibrahim Ba Qusyair. Beliau memiliki mujahadah yang agung. Syaikh ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf berkata, “Orang-orang di zaman kami sepakat bahwa Syaikh ‘Abdullah bin ‘Alawi adalah sisa dari para mujtahid.” Beliau bermukim di Makkah selama delapan tahun, menyertai para ulama dan orang shalihnya; dua kali penduduk Makkah memohon hujan dengan perantaraannya, dan dua kali pula hujan turun. Beliau kembali ke Tarim setelah saudaranya, ‘Ali, wafat. Beliau sangat gemar berinfak dan bersedekah, bahkan menyedekahkan untuk Masjid Ba ‘Alawi harta senilai 90.000 dinar. Beliau wafat di Tarim pada hari Rabu, pertengahan Jumadil Ula 731 H.
passages.en: Al-Shaykh al-Imam Abdullah bin Alawi bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam was born in 638 AH or 640 AH in Tarim and raised there. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He was with his grandfather al-Faqih, when he was a child. He took from his father who nurtured him. He sought knowledge and surpassed his peers. He took from the jurist Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman bin Alawi and Shaykh Ibrahim Ba Qushayr. His acts of spiritual striving were immense. Shaykh Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf said, “The people of our time are unanimous about Shaykh Abdullah bin Alawi being among the last remaining Mujtahids.” He spent eight years in Makkah and kept the company of its scholars and pious people. The people of Makkah prayed for rain through him twice and were granted rain both times. After his brother Ali passed away, he returned to Tarim. He would spend greatly in charity. He spent the equivalent of 90 thousand dinars on the Ba Alawi mosque. He passed away in Tarim on Wednesday, mid-Jumad al-Ula in 731 AH (1331).

passages.sub: Shaykh Muhammad Mawla ad-Dawilah
passages.ar: هو الإمام محمد بن علي بن علوي بن محمد الفقيه المقدم، وُلد بتريم ونشأ بها، وحفظ نصف القرآن، وكان إذا غلط القارئ في النصف الآخر رده إلى الصواب، مات أبوه وهو صغير فكفله عمه الشيخ عبد الله باعلوي ورباه، وكان له المجاهدات العظيمة، مكثَ نحو عشرين سنة يصلي الصبح بوضوء العشاء، وكان إذا قرأ آيات الخوف تقع لسانه كأنه جمره ويُرى على شفته الحريق من شدة الخوف، وكان إذا قرأ في المصحف يستغرق في القراءة والتدبر فربما أُخِذَ منهُ وهو لا يشعر، وله الكرامات العظيمة والمناقب الجسيمة، توفي يوم الاثنين ١٠ شعبان سنة ٧٦٥هـ ودُفن بزنبل.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâm Muhammad bin `Alî bin `Alawî bin Muhammad al-Faqîhil-Muqaddam, wulida bi-Tarîm wa nasya'a bihâ, wa hafizha nishfal-Qur'ân, wa kâna idzâ ghalithal-qâri'u fin-nishfil-âkhari raddahû ilash-shawâb, mâta abûhu wa huwa shaghîrun fakafalahû `ammuhusy-Syaikh `Abdullâh Bâ`alawî wa rabbâh, wa kâna lahul-mujâhadâtul-`azhîmah, makatsa nahwa `isyrîna sanatan yushallish-shubha biwudhû'il-`isyâ', wa kâna idzâ qara'a âyâtil-khaufi taqa`u lisânuhû ka'annahû jamrah wa yurâ `alâ syafatihil-harîqu min syiddatil-khauf, wa kâna idzâ qara'a fil-mush-hafi yastaghriqu fil-qirâ'ati wat-tadabburi farubbamâ ukhidza minhu wa huwa lâ yasy`ur, wa lahul-karâmâtul-`azhîmatu wal-manâqibul-jasîmah, tuwuffiya yaumal-itsnain 10 Sya`bân sanata 765 H wa dufina bi-Zanbal.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Muhammad bin ‘Ali bin ‘Alawi bin Muhammad al-Faqih al-Muqaddam. Lahir dan besar di Tarim, beliau hafal separuh Al-Qur'an, namun jika ada pembaca yang keliru pada separuh lainnya, beliau dapat langsung membenarkannya. Ayahnya wafat ketika beliau masih kecil, sehingga beliau diasuh dan dididik oleh pamannya, Syaikh ‘Abdullah Ba ‘Alawi. Beliau memiliki mujahadah yang agung: selama sekitar dua puluh tahun beliau shalat Subuh dengan wudhu shalat Isya. Setiap kali membaca ayat-ayat yang menakutkan, lidahnya seakan bara dan pada bibirnya tampak bekas terbakar karena dahsyatnya rasa takut. Setiap kali membaca mushaf, beliau tenggelam dalam bacaan dan tadabbur, sampai-sampai bila mushaf diambil darinya beliau tidak menyadarinya. Beliau memiliki karamah-karamah agung dan keutamaan-keutamaan besar. Beliau wafat pada hari Senin, 10 Sya‘ban 765 H, dan dimakamkan di Zanbal.
passages.en: Imam Muhammad bin Ali bin Alawi bin Muhammad al-Faqih al-Muqaddam was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized half of the Quran. If someone made a mistake while reciting the other half, he would correct the reciter. His father passed away when he was young. His paternal uncle, Shaykh Abdullah Ba Alawi, therefore took care of him and nurtured him. His acts of mujahadah (spiritual striving) were immense. For around twenty years he prayed the Fajr prayer using the same wudhu (ablution) as the Isha prayer. Whenever he recited verses of fear, his tongue would become like a coal, and his lip would become fiery out of extreme fear. He would not even notice if the mushaf was taken from him while he was reading the Quran because he would be completely engrossed in recitation and reflection. He had great miracles and extraordinary virtues. He passed away on Monday, 10th Shaban, 765 AH (1364), and was buried in Zanbal.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf
passages.ar: هو الإمام المُقدّم الثاني الشيخ عبد الرحمن السقاف بن محمد مولى الدّويلة، ولد سنة ٧٣٩هـ بتريم، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، لُقّب بالسّقاف لأنّه سقفَ على أحوال الأولياء وفاقهم، أخذ عن كثير من الأئمة الأعلام، منهم: العلامة محمد بن علوي بن أحمد بن الفقيه المقدم (المعروف بصاحب العمائم) والشيخ محمد باشكيل والشيخ محمد بن أبي بكر باعباد ولازمه حتى تخرّج به، وقرأ في مختلف فنون العلم من: (التّنبيه)، و(البسيط)، وغيرها، و(إحياء علوم الدّين)، وكتب التصوف، وكانت له مجاهدات عظيمة، كانَ يقرأ من القرآن أربعَ ختمات بالليل، وأربع بالنّهار، وكانَ يُرى كأنّه سارية من طول قيامه بالليل، له تلامذة كثيرون، وله كلام فائق، توفي بتريم يوم الخميس ٣ شعبان سنة ٨١٩هـ، وقبرهُ بزنبل.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Muqaddamuts-tsânî asy-Syaikh `Abdurrahmân as-Saqqâf bin Muhammad Maulad-Dawîlah, wulida sanata 739 H bi-Tarîm, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, luqqiba bis-Saqqâf li'annahû saqafa `alâ ahwâlil-auliyâ'i wa fâqahum, akhadza `an katsîrin minal-a'immatil-a`lâm, minhum: al-`allâmah Muhammad bin `Alawî bin Ahmad bin al-Faqîhil-Muqaddam (al-ma`rûfu bi-Shâhibil-`Amâ'im) wasy-Syaikh Muhammad Bâsyakîl wasy-Syaikh Muhammad bin Abî Bakr Bâ`abbâd wa lâzamahû hattâ takharraja bih, wa qara'a fî mukhtalafi funûnil-`ilmi min: (at-Tanbîh), wa (al-Basîth), wa ghairihâ, wa (Ihyâ'i `Ulûmid-Dîn), wa kutubit-tashawwuf, wa kânat lahû mujâhadâtun `azhîmah, kâna yaqra'u minal-Qur'âni arba`a khatamâtin bil-laili, wa arba`a bin-nahâr, wa kâna yurâ ka'annahû sâriyatun min thûli qiyâmihî bil-lail, lahû talâmidzatun katsîrûn, wa lahû kalâmun fâ'iq, tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm yaumal-khamîs 3 Sya`bân sanata 819 H, wa qabruhû bi-Zanbal.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Muqaddam ats-Tsani, Syaikh ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf bin Muhammad Maula ad-Dawilah. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 739 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan dijuluki as-Saqqaf (atap) karena keadaannya menaungi dan melampaui hal para wali di masanya. Beliau belajar dari banyak imam terkemuka, di antaranya al-‘Allamah Muhammad bin ‘Alawi bin Ahmad bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam (yang dikenal sebagai Shahib al-‘Ama'im), Syaikh Muhammad Basyakil, dan Syaikh Muhammad bin Abu Bakar Ba ‘Abbad, yang terus didampinginya hingga lulus darinya. Beliau membaca berbagai disiplin ilmu, seperti at-Tanbih, al-Basith, dan lainnya, serta Ihya' ‘Ulumiddin dan kitab-kitab tasawuf. Beliau memiliki mujahadah yang agung: mengkhatamkan Al-Qur'an empat kali di malam hari dan empat kali di siang hari, dan tampak seperti tiang karena lamanya berdiri shalat malam. Beliau memiliki banyak murid dan ucapan-ucapan yang indah. Beliau wafat di Tarim pada hari Kamis, 3 Sya‘ban 819 H, dan makamnya di Zanbal.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Muqaddam al-Thani (the second Muqaddam) Shaykh Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf bin Muhammad Mawla ad-Dawilah was born in 739 AH (1338) in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He was called as-Saqqaf because he rose above his contemporaries in spiritual state until he became like a ceiling (saqf) on top of them. He took from many eminent Imams, including the erudite scholar Muhammad bin Alawi bin Ahmad bin al-Faqih al-Muqaddam (well-known as Sahib al-Ama'im), Shaykh Muhammad Ba Shakil, and Shaykh Muhammad bin Abu Bakr Ba Abbad, whom he adhered to and was educated by. He read various fields of knowledge, including at-Tanbih, al-Basit and other books of jurisprudence, as well as Ihya Ulum ad-Din and other books of Sufism. His acts of spiritual striving were immense. He would recite the whole Quran four times during the night and four times during the day. His lengthy standing in worship at night would make him appear to be a pillar. He had many students, and outstanding oration. He passed away in Tarim on Thursday, 3rd Shaban 819 AH (1416). His grave is in Zanbal.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abu Bakr as-Sakran
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الشيخ أبوبكر السكران بن عبد الرحمن السقاف، وُلد بتريم وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وتربى بأبيه الذي كان يحبه ويُثني عليه ولازمه ولبس منه الخرقة، وكان مُستغرقًا بذكر الله تعالى والدعاء، وكان صاحب خوف وربما غَيّبَهُ عن إحساسه فيمشي كالسكران، أو ربما غَلَبَهُ الوجْد فيصير هكذا فلُقّب بالسكران، وكان يجتمع بالخِضر ورجال الغيب، وله كرامات كثيرة، ولا تقع منه إلا حال غيبته، وإذا افاق أنكر ذلك وقال:
ما شعرت بذلك وما فعلته ولا قلته! وكان يقول: "ما نلتُ الذي نلت إلا بكثرة حُسن ظني بالصالحين وجميع المسلمين" توفي سنة ٨٢١هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh Abûbakrinis-Sakrân bin `Abdirrahmân as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Tarîm wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa tarabbâ bi'abîhil-ladzî kâna yuhibbuhû wa yutsnî `alaihi wa lâzamahû wa labisa minhul-khirqah, wa kâna mustaghriqan bidzikrillâhi ta`âlâ wad-du`â', wa kâna shâhiba khaufin wa rubbamâ ghayyabahû `an ihsâsihî fayamsyî kas-sakrân, au rubbamâ ghalabahul-wajdu fayashîru hâkadzâ faluqqiba bis-Sakrân, wa kâna yajtami`u bil-Khidhri wa rijâlil-ghaib, wa lahû karâmâtun katsîrah, wa lâ taqa`u minhu illâ hâla ghaibatih, wa idzâ afâqa ankara dzâlika wa qâl: mâ sya`artu bidzâlika wa mâ fa`altuhû wa lâ qultuh! Wa kâna yaqûl: "mâ niltul-ladzî niltu illâ bikatsrati husni zhannî bish-shâlihîna wa jamî`il-muslimîn" tuwuffiya sanata 821 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh Abu Bakar as-Sakran bin ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf. Lahir dan besar di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan dididik oleh ayahnya yang sangat mencintai dan memujinya; beliau terus mendampinginya dan menerima khirqah darinya. Beliau senantiasa tenggelam dalam dzikir dan doa kepada Allah ta‘ala. Beliau pemilik rasa takut yang dahsyat, yang terkadang membuatnya hilang kesadaran hingga berjalan seperti orang mabuk, atau terkadang wajd (luapan ekstase ruhani) menguasainya hingga menjadi demikian, sehingga beliau dijuluki as-Sakran. Beliau biasa berjumpa dengan Khidir dan para rijalul ghaib. Beliau memiliki banyak karamah, yang hanya terjadi dalam keadaan ghaibah (fana); ketika tersadar beliau mengingkarinya dan berkata, “Aku tidak merasakannya, tidak melakukannya, dan tidak mengucapkannya!” Beliau sering berkata, “Aku tidak mencapai apa yang kucapai kecuali karena banyaknya prasangka baikku kepada orang-orang shalih dan seluruh kaum muslimin.” Beliau wafat pada tahun 821 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Abu Bakr as-Sakran bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He was nurtured by his father who loved and praised him. He adhered to his father who invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah). He was engrossed in remembrance of Allah the Exalted and in supplication. He possessed great fear of Allah, which at times would grip him until it was as though he was intoxicated. At times, he would be overwhelmed with spiritual ecstasy. He was thus named as-Sakran (the intoxicated). He would meet with al-Khidhr and the saints of the unseen. He had many miracles, which would only appear while he was in a state of ghaybah (being spiritually absent from all other than Allah). When he would come to, he would disacknowledge the miracle and say, “I didn't sense that. I didn't do it. I didn't say it!” He would say, “I only attained what I attained by greatly having a good opinion of the righteous and all Muslims.” He passed away in 821 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Umar al-Mihdhar
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الشيخ عمر المحضار عبد الرحمن السقاف، ولد بتريم، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وتربى بأبيه، وطلب العلم واجتهد في تحصيله، وكان حَسن الحفظ سريعَه، وربما مر على الكتاب فيحفظه جميعه، وكان يحفظ (منهاج النووي) في الفقه، وكاد أن يحفظ (الحقائق) للسلمي في التفسير، وكان كثير المُجاهدات، شديد الخوف من رب البريات، وكان يتلو اسم الله (اللطيف) ألف مرة في نفَس واحد، وكان الأولياء يقولون:
أنه يغضب لغضبه جبار السماوات والأرض ويرضى لرضاه، توفي يوم الاثنين ٢ ذي القعدة سنة ٨٣٣هـ وهو ساجد في صلاة الظهر، ودُفن بزنبل.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh `Umar al-Mihdhâr `Abdurrahmân as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Tarîm, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa tarabbâ bi'abîh, wa thalabal-`ilma wajtahada fî tahshîlih, wa kâna hasanal-hifzhi sarî`ah, wa rubbamâ marra `alal-kitâbi fayahfazhuhû jamî`ah, wa kâna yahfazhu (Minhâjan-Nawawî) fil-fiqh, wa kâda an yahfazha (al-Haqâ'iq) lis-Sulamî fit-tafsîr, wa kâna katsîral-mujâhadât, syadîdal-khaufi min rabbil-bariyyât, wa kâna yatlû ismallâhi (al-Lathîf) alfa marratin fî nafasin wâhid, wa kânal-auliyâ'u yaqûlûn: annahû yaghdhabu lighadhabihî jabbârus-samâwâti wal-ardhi wa yardhâ liridhâh, tuwuffiya yaumal-itsnain 2 Dzil-Qa`dah sanata 833 H wa huwa sâjidun fî shalâtizh-zhuhr, wa dufina bi-Zanbal.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh ‘Umar al-Mihdhar bin ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf. Lahir di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, tumbuh besar di sana dalam didikan ayahnya, serta menuntut ilmu dan bersungguh-sungguh meraihnya. Hafalannya bagus dan cepat — terkadang beliau cukup melewati sebuah kitab dan langsung hafal seluruhnya. Beliau hafal kitab Minhaj karya an-Nawawi dalam ilmu fikih dan nyaris hafal kitab al-Haqa'iq karya as-Sulami dalam ilmu tafsir. Beliau banyak bermujahadah dan sangat takut kepada Tuhan seluruh makhluk. Beliau biasa membaca nama Allah “al-Lathif” seribu kali dalam satu tarikan napas. Para wali berkata bahwa Penguasa langit dan bumi murka karena kemurkaannya dan ridha karena keridhaannya. Beliau wafat pada hari Senin, 2 Dzulqa‘dah 833 H, dalam keadaan sujud pada shalat Zuhur, dan dimakamkan di Zanbal.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Umar al-Mihdhar bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf was born and raised in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran and was nurtured by his father. He sought knowledge and strove to attain it. He would memorize very quickly. He might quickly scan through a book and memorize it in its entirety. He knew Minhaj at-Talibin by an-Nawawi in jurisprudence by heart and practically knew the whole of al-Haqaiq by as-Sulami in Quranic exegesis by heart. His acts of spiritual struggle were many. He had intense fear of the Lord of creation. He would recite Allah's Name “Al-Latif” a thousand times in one breath. The saints would say that Allah, the Compeller of the heavens and the earth, would be angered by what angers him and pleased by what pleases him. He passed away in prostration in the Dhuhr prayer on Monday, 2nd Dhul Qa'dah, 833 AH (1430). He was buried in Zanbal.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abdullah al-Aydarus
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الشيخ عبد الله العيدروس بن أبي بكر السكران، ولد في ذي الحجة سنة ٨١١هـ وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها، وحلّ عليه نظر جده، وتربى بأبيه وبعمه الشيخ عمر المحضار ولازمه، وألبسه الخرقة، وابتدأ في مجاهدات النفس وهو ابن سبع سنين، وأخذ في جميع فنون العلم عن كثير، وقرأ (الإحياء)، وكاد أن يحفظه وأطنبَ في مدحه، وكان شديد التواضع حتى أنه كان يجلس على المزابل كسرًا للنفس، ولا يرى نفسه خيرًا من أحد، فرفع الله مكانته ونال ما لا يخطر ببال، ومن كلامه:
"من أراد الصفاء الرباني، فعليه بالانكسار في جوف الليل"، توفي يوم الأحد ١٢ رمضان سنة ٨٦٥هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh `Abdullâhil-`Aidarûs bin Abî Bakrinis-Sakrân, wulida fî Dzil-Hijjah sanata 811 H wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ, wa halla `alaihi nazharu jaddih, wa tarabbâ bi'abîhi wa bi`ammihisy-Syaikh `Umar al-Mihdhâr wa lâzamah, wa albasahul-khirqah, wabtada'a fî mujâhadâtin-nafsi wa huwabnu sab`i sinîn, wa akhadza fî jamî`i funûnil-`ilmi `an katsîr, wa qara'a (al-Ihyâ'), wa kâda an yahfazhahû wa athnaba fî mad-hih, wa kâna syadîdat-tawâdhu`i hattâ annahû kâna yajlisu `alal-mazâbili kasran lin-nafs, wa lâ yarâ nafsahû khairan min ahad, farafa`allâhu makânatahû wa nâla mâ lâ yakhthuru bibâl, wa min kalâmih: "man arâdash-shafâ'ar-rabbânî, fa`alaihi bil-inkisâri fî jaufil-lail", tuwuffiya yaumal-ahad 12 Ramadhân sanata 865 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh ‘Abdullah al-‘Aydarus bin Abu Bakar as-Sakran. Lahir pada bulan Dzulhijjah tahun 811 H di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan tumbuh besar di sana dalam naungan pandangan kakeknya. Beliau dididik oleh ayahnya dan pamannya, Syaikh ‘Umar al-Mihdhar, yang terus didampinginya dan darinya beliau menerima khirqah. Beliau memulai mujahadah jiwa sejak usia tujuh tahun dan menimba semua cabang ilmu dari banyak ulama. Beliau membaca kitab Ihya' hingga nyaris menghafalnya dan memujinya dengan panjang lebar. Beliau sangat rendah hati, sampai-sampai pernah duduk di atas tumpukan sampah demi menundukkan nafsunya, dan tidak pernah memandang dirinya lebih baik dari siapa pun; maka Allah mengangkat kedudukannya hingga ia meraih apa yang tak terbayangkan. Di antara ucapannya, “Barang siapa menginginkan kejernihan rabbani, hendaklah ia bersimpuh hancur di tengah malam.” Beliau wafat pada hari Ahad, 12 Ramadhan 865 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Abdullah al-Aydarus bin Abu Bakr as-Sakran was born in Dhul Hijjah 811 AH (1409) in Tarim, and raised there. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He was under the gaze of his grandfather. He was nurtured by his father and his uncle, Shaykh Umar al-Mihdhar, to whom he adhered and who invested him with the noble mantle (khirqah). He began to engage in acts of spiritual struggle when he was seven. He took from many scholars in all fields of knowledge. He read the Ihya, practically knew it by heart, and praised it at great length. He was extremely humble. He would even sit where refuse was thrown to break any ego. He never saw himself as better than anyone. Thus, Allah raised his standing, and he attained the unimaginable. He said, “Whoever desires divine purity must be in a state of brokenness in the depths of the night.” He passed away on Sunday, 12th Ramadhan in 865 AH (1461).

passages.sub: Shaykh Ali bin Abu Bakr as-Sakran
passages.ar: هو الشيخ الإمام علي بن أبي بكر السكران، ولد بتريم سنة ٨١٨هـ، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وبشّر به جده وأبوه وكفله عمه الشيخ عمر المحضار ولازمه وصحب أخاه الشيخ عبد الله العيدروس، أخذ العلم عن كثير ورحل فيه إلى الشحر وغيل باوَزير، ومكث هناك أربع سنين، وكان عالما عاملا، ورعا زاهدا، لا تُذكر الدنيا في مجلسه، وكان خاشعا خاضعا إذا صلى لا يسهُ في صلاته، ولا يُرى إلا وهو يتلو أو يذكر الله أو يصلي، له مؤلفات عديدة، توفي سنة ٨٩٥هـ.
passages.tr: Huwasy-Syaikhul-Imâm `Alî bin Abî Bakrinis-Sakrân, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 818 H, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa busysyira bihî jadduhû wa abûhu wa kafalahû `ammuhusy-Syaikh `Umar al-Mihdhâr wa lâzamahû wa shahiba akhâhusy-Syaikh `Abdallâhil-`Aidarûs, akhadzal-`ilma `an katsîrin wa rahala fîhi ilasy-Syihri wa Ghaili Bâwazîr, wa makatsa hunâka arba`a sinîn, wa kâna `âliman `âmilâ, wari`an zâhidâ, lâ tudzkarud-dunyâ fî majlisih, wa kâna khâsyi`an khâdhi`an idzâ shallâ lâ yas-hu fî shalâtih, wa lâ yurâ illâ wa huwa yatlû au yadzkurullâha au yushallî, lahû mu'allafâtun `adîdah, tuwuffiya sanata 895 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah asy-Syaikh al-Imam ‘Ali bin Abu Bakar as-Sakran. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 818 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan tumbuh besar di sana; kakek dan ayahnya memberi kabar gembira tentangnya. Beliau diasuh oleh pamannya, Syaikh ‘Umar al-Mihdhar, yang terus didampinginya, dan bersahabat erat dengan saudaranya, Syaikh ‘Abdullah al-‘Aydarus. Beliau menimba ilmu dari banyak ulama, hingga merantau ke Syihr dan Ghail Bawazir dan bermukim di sana selama empat tahun. Beliau seorang alim yang mengamalkan ilmunya, wara‘, dan zahid; dunia tidak pernah disebut-sebut di majelisnya. Beliau khusyuk lagi tunduk — bila shalat, beliau tidak pernah lalai dalam shalatnya — dan tidak pernah terlihat kecuali sedang membaca Al-Qur'an, berdzikir, atau shalat. Beliau memiliki banyak karangan. Beliau wafat pada tahun 895 H.
passages.en: Al-Shaykh al-Imam Ali bin Abu Bakr as-Sakran was born in Tarim in 818 AH, and raised there. He memorized the Glorious Quran. His grandfather and father gave glad tidings about him. His uncle, Shaykh Umar al-Mihdhar, to whom he adhered, took care of him. He kept the company of his brother, Shaykh Abdullah al-Aydarus. He took knowledge from many, and traveled to seek it out in Shihr and Ghayl Ba Wazir. He remained there for four years. He was a scholar who acted on his knowledge. He was scrupulous and detached from the lower world. The world would not be mentioned in his gathering. He feared Allah and was humble. He was never inattentive in prayer. He was only seen reciting, remembering Allah or praying. He authored several books. He passed away in 895 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abu Bakr al-Adani bin Abdullah al-Aydarus
passages.ar:
هو الشيخ الإمام أبوبكر العدني بن عبد الله العيدروس، ولد بتريم سنة ٨٥١هـ، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، قالَ والده:
"بُشرتُ بولد من أهل الولاية والعناية والمكارم"،
وقرأ العلم على الفقيه عبد الله بلحاج بافضل وغيره، وعلى والده وعَمَّيْه الشيخ علي والشيخ أحمد في التصوف وغيرهم، وكانَ كثير الخشية، غزير الدّمعة، أجلسهُ والده قبل موته مجلس المشيخة وأجازه في الإقراء والتدريس والإلباس وهو ابنُ ١٤ سنة، وكانَ يحب العلم ويكرم أهله، ويحب قراءة الكتب ويعتني بها، وكانَ كثير التبسم دائم البِشر، تعجبه المُفاكَهة والمُداعبة في العِشرة والمُصاحبة مع الصِّيانة عن ذكر ما لا يَليق من قول أو فعل، مناقبه كثيرة مبسوطة في المُطوّلات، توفي بعدن يوم الثلاثاء ١٤ شوال سنة ٩١٤هـ.
passages.tr: Huwasy-Syaikhul-Imâm Abûbakrinil-`Adanî bin `Abdillâhil-`Aidarûs, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 851 H, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, qâla wâliduh: "busyirtu biwaladin min ahlil-wilâyati wal-`inâyati wal-makârim", wa qara'al-`ilma `alal-Faqîh `Abdillâh Balhâj Bâfadhl wa ghairih, wa `alâ wâlidihî wa `ammaihisy-Syaikh `Alî wasy-Syaikh Ahmad fit-tashawwufi wa ghairihim, wa kâna katsîral-khasyyah, ghazîrad-dam`ah, ajlasahû wâliduhû qabla mautihî majlisal-masyyakhati wa ajâzahû fil-iqrâ'i wat-tadrîsi wal-ilbâsi wa huwabnu 14 sanah, wa kâna yuhibbul-`ilma wa yukrimu ahlah, wa yuhibbu qirâ'atal-kutubi wa ya`tanî bihâ, wa kâna katsîrat-tabassumi dâ'imal-bisyr, tu`jibuhul-mufâkahatu wal-mudâ`abatu fil-`isyrati wal-mushâhabati ma`ash-shiyânati `an dzikri mâ lâ yalîqu min qaulin au fi`l, manâqibuhû katsîratun mabsûthatun fil-muthawwalât, tuwuffiya bi-`Adan yaumats-tsulâtsâ' 14 Syawwâl sanata 914 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah asy-Syaikh al-Imam Abu Bakar al-‘Adni bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Aydarus. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 851 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung. Ayahnya berkata, “Aku diberi kabar gembira akan seorang anak yang termasuk ahli kewalian, penjagaan ilahi, dan kemuliaan budi.” Beliau membaca ilmu kepada al-Faqih ‘Abdullah Balhaj Bafadhal dan lainnya, serta kepada ayahnya dan kedua pamannya, Syaikh ‘Ali dan Syaikh Ahmad, dalam ilmu tasawuf dan lainnya. Beliau sangat besar rasa takutnya kepada Allah dan mudah mencucurkan air mata. Sebelum wafat, ayahnya mendudukkannya di majelis kemasyayikhan dan memberinya ijazah untuk membacakan kitab, mengajar, dan memakaikan khirqah pada usia 14 tahun. Beliau mencintai ilmu dan memuliakan ahlinya, gemar membaca kitab dan memeliharanya. Beliau murah senyum dan selalu berseri wajahnya, menyukai canda dan kelakar dalam pergaulan dan persahabatan, dengan tetap menjaga diri dari ucapan atau perbuatan yang tidak pantas. Manaqibnya banyak dan terurai panjang dalam kitab-kitab besar. Beliau wafat di Aden pada hari Selasa, 14 Syawal 914 H.
passages.en: Al-Shaykh al-Imam Abu Bakr al-Adani bin Abdullah al-Aydarus was born in Tarim in 851 AH. He memorized the Glorious Quran. His father said before his birth: “I have been given good tidings of a child who will be amongst the people of wilayah (sainthood), who will receive special care (inayah) and who will be someone of noble character.” He studied at the hands of the jurist Abdullah Bilhaj Ba Fadhl and others. He studied Sufism at the hands of his father and two paternal uncles Shaykh Ali and Shaykh Ahmad, and others. He had great fear of Allah. He would weep a lot. When he was 14 years old, his father appointed him as a shaykh of the inward and outward sciences and authorized him to teach and invest others with the mantle. He loved knowledge and honored its people. He loved reading books and was solicitous about it. He would smile a lot and was always joyful. He liked banter among family and companions while avoiding any inappropriate word or act. His virtues are many and have been detailed in large volumes. He passed away in Aden on Tuesday, 14th Shawwal in 914 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abdur Rahman bin Shaykh Ali
passages.ar: هو الإمام الشيخ عبد الرحمن بن الشيخ علي بن أبي بكر السكران، ولد بتريم سنة ٨٥٠هـ وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ونشأ بها وتأدب بأبيه ولازمه وتخرج به، وأخذ عن عمّيه الشيخ عبد الله العيدروس والشيخ أحمد وعن كثير من العلماء الأعلام في مختلف العلوم، ورحل إلى عدن ومكث بها يطلب العلم أربع سنوات، ورحل إلى زبيد والحرمين، حَفِظ الحاوي في الفقه، والوردية في النحو، قرأ (الإحياء) على والده أربعين مرة، وقرئ عليه كذلك أربعين مرة، توفي سنة ٩٢٣هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh `Abdurrahmân bin asy-Syaikh `Alî bin Abî Bakrinis-Sakrân, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 850 H wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa nasya'a bihâ wa ta'addaba bi'abîhi wa lâzamahû wa takharraja bih, wa akhadza `an `ammaihisy-Syaikh `Abdillâhil-`Aidarûs wasy-Syaikh Ahmad wa `an katsîrin minal-`ulamâ'il-a`lâmi fî mukhtalafil-`ulûm, wa rahala ilâ `Adan wa makatsa bihâ yathlubul-`ilma arba`a sanawât, wa rahala ilâ Zabîd wal-Haramain, hafizhal-Hâwî fil-fiqh, wal-Wardiyyata fin-nahw, qara'a (al-Ihyâ') `alâ wâlidihî arba`îna marrah, wa quri'a `alaihi kadzâlika arba`îna marrah, tuwuffiya sanata 923 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh ‘Abdurrahman bin Syaikh ‘Ali bin Abu Bakar as-Sakran. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 850 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, tumbuh besar di sana, mengambil adab dari ayahnya, terus mendampinginya, dan lulus dari didikannya. Beliau menimba ilmu dari kedua pamannya, Syaikh ‘Abdullah al-‘Aydarus dan Syaikh Ahmad, serta dari banyak ulama terkemuka dalam berbagai bidang ilmu. Beliau merantau ke Aden dan bermukim di sana empat tahun untuk menuntut ilmu, lalu ke Zabid dan al-Haramain. Beliau hafal kitab al-Hawi dalam fikih dan al-Wardiyyah dalam nahwu, membaca kitab Ihya' kepada ayahnya empat puluh kali, dan kitab itu pun dibacakan di hadapannya empat puluh kali pula. Beliau wafat pada tahun 923 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Abdur Rahman bin Shaykh Ali bin Abu Bakr as-Sakran was born in Tarim in 850 AH, and raised there. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He came to imitate his father in all his states and actions, who he adhered to and was educated by. He took from his two paternal uncles Shaykh Abdullah al-Aydarus and Shaykh Ahmad, and from many scholarly authorities in various fields of knowledge. He traveled to Aden and spent four years there in order to seek knowledge. He traveled to Zabid and to the two Sacred Sanctuaries. He memorized al-Hawi in jurisprudence and al-Wardiyyah in grammar. He studied the entire Ihya forty times under his father. Others then studied it in its entirety under Shaykh Abdur Rahman forty times as well. He passed away in 923 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Ahmad Shihabuddin bin Abdur Rahman
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الشيخ أحمد شهاب الدين بن عبد الرحمن، ولد بتريم سنة ٨٨٧هـ، وحفظ القرآن العظيم، وتأدب بأبيه، وأخذ عنه التصوف، وأدرك جده الشيخ علي، أخذ العلم عن كثير، منهم القاضي أحمد شريف والمحدث محمد بن علي خرد وهو أيضًا أخذ عن الشيخ أحمد، وأخذ عن ابن حجر المكي وأبي الحسن البكري، مناقبه كثيرة، وله قصائد عظيمة، من كلامه:
"من نظر إلى المشايخ بعين العصمة حُرِمَ بركتهم، ومن نظر إليهم بعين التعظيم رُزِق بركتهم ولَحِقَ بهم وإن لم يعمل بعملهم" أخذ عنه العلم جملة من الأكابر، منهم الشيخ أبوبكر بن سالم وغيره، توفي سنة ٩٤٦هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh Ahmad Syihâbuddîn bin `Abdirrahmân, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 887 H, wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa ta'addaba bi'abîh, wa akhadza `anhut-tashawwuf, wa adraka jaddahusy-Syaikh `Alî, akhadzal-`ilma `an katsîr, minhumul-Qâdhî Ahmad Syarîf wal-muhaddits Muhammad bin `Alî Khird wa huwa aidhan akhadza `anisy-Syaikh Ahmad, wa akhadza `anibni Hajaril-Makkî wa Abil-Hasanil-Bakrî, manâqibuhû katsîrah, wa lahû qashâ'idu `azhîmah, min kalâmih: "man nazhara ilal-masyâyikhi bi`ainil-`ishmati hurima barakatahum, wa man nazhara ilaihim bi`ainit-ta`zhîmi ruziqa barakatahum wa lahiqa bihim wa in lam ya`mal bi`amalihim" akhadza `anhul-`ilma jumlatun minal-akâbir, minhumusy-Syaikh Abûbakr bin Sâlim wa ghairuh, tuwuffiya sanata 946 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh Ahmad Syihabuddin bin ‘Abdurrahman. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 887 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung, mengambil adab dari ayahnya dan belajar tasawuf darinya, serta sempat menjumpai kakeknya, Syaikh ‘Ali. Beliau menimba ilmu dari banyak ulama, di antaranya al-Qadhi Ahmad Syarif dan al-Muhaddits Muhammad bin ‘Ali Khird — yang juga mengambil ilmu dari Syaikh Ahmad — serta dari Ibnu Hajar al-Makki dan Abul Hasan al-Bakri. Manaqibnya banyak dan beliau memiliki qasidah-qasidah yang agung. Di antara ucapannya, “Barang siapa memandang para masyayikh dengan pandangan maksum, ia terhalang dari keberkahan mereka. Dan barang siapa memandang mereka dengan pandangan pengagungan, ia dikaruniai keberkahan mereka dan menyusul mereka, meskipun tidak beramal seperti amalan mereka.” Sejumlah ulama besar mengambil ilmu darinya, di antaranya Syaikh Abu Bakar bin Salim dan lainnya. Beliau wafat pada tahun 946 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Ahmad Shihabuddin bin Abdur Rahman was born in Tarim in 887 AH. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He came to imitate his father in all his states and actions. He took Sufism from him. He was with his grandfather, Shaykh Ali, when he was a child. He took knowledge from many, including the Qadhi Ahmad Sharif, and the Muhaddith Muhammad bin Ali Khirad who also took from Shaykh Ahmad. He took from ibn Hajar al-Makki and Abul Hasan al-Bakri. His virtues are many, and he has great poems. From his speech is, “Whoever looks at the Shaykhs with the eye of infallibility will be deprived of their blessing. Whoever looks at them with the eye of reverence will be granted their blessing, and be with them even if he doesn't perform their deeds.” Many elite scholars took from him, such as Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim and others. He passed away in 946 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim
passages.ar: هو الإمام الشيخ أبوبكر بن سالم بن عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن السقاف، ولد بتريم سنة ٩١٩هـ، ونشأ بها مشتغلًا بتحصيل العلوم وتحقيقها، وقرأ (المنهاج) للنووي ثلاث مرات، وقرأ (الإحياء) للإمام الغزالي وطالعه أربعين مرة، وأخذَ عن كثير من العلماء، منهم: السيد عمر باشيْبان والشيخ أحمد باجَحدب والفقيه الصوفي عمر بامَخْرمة والشيخ شهاب الدّين أحمد بن عبد الرحمن، وعندما بلغ سبعًا وعشرين سنة.. انتقل إلى قرية عينات ومكث فيها داعيًا إلى الله، له تآليف عديدة وقصائد فريدة، أخذَ عنهُ كثيرون، منهم: أولاده المُباركون عمر المحضار والحُسين وبقية إخوانهم، والإمام صاحب الشعب أحمد بن محمد الحبشي، والإمام عبد الرحمن الجفري صاحب تَريس، والسيد يوسف بن عابد الحسني المغربي، له مجاهدات كثيرة، توفي بعِينات ليلة الأحد ٢٧ ذي الحجّة سنة ٩٩٢هـ.
