passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikh Abûbakr bin Sâlim bin `Abdillâh bin `Abdirrahmân bin `Abdillâh bin `Abdirrahmân as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 919 H, wa nasya'a bihâ musytaghilan bitahshîlil-`ulûmi wa tahqîqihâ, wa qara'a (al-Minhâj) lin-Nawawî tsalâtsa marrât, wa qara'a (al-Ihyâ') lil-Imâmil-Ghazâlî wa thâla`ahû arba`îna marrah, wa akhadza `an katsîrin minal-`ulamâ', minhum: as-Sayyid `Umar Bâsyaibân wasy-Syaikh Ahmad Bâjahdab wal-faqîhush-shûfî `Umar Bâmakhramah wasy-Syaikh Syihâbuddîn Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân, wa `indamâ balagha sab`an wa `isyrîna sanah.. intaqala ilâ qaryati `Înât wa makatsa fîhâ dâ`iyan ilallâh, lahû ta'âlîfu `adîdatun wa qashâ'idu farîdah, akhadza `anhu katsîrûn, minhum: aulâduhul-mubârakûn `Umar al-Mihdhâr wal-Husain wa baqiyyatu ikhwânihim, wal-Imâm Shâhibusy-Syi`b Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Habasyî, wal-Imâm `Abdurrahmân al-Jifrî Shâhibu Tarîs, was-Sayyid Yûsuf bin `Âbid al-Hasanî al-Maghribî, lahû mujâhadâtun katsîrah, tuwuffiya bi-`Înât lailatal-ahad 27 Dzil-Hijjah sanata 992 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh Abu Bakar bin Salim bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abdurrahman bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf. Lahir di Tarim pada tahun 919 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana dengan kesibukan menuntut dan mendalami ilmu. Beliau membaca kitab al-Minhaj karya an-Nawawi tiga kali, serta membaca dan menelaah Ihya' karya al-Imam al-Ghazali empat puluh kali. Beliau belajar dari banyak ulama, di antaranya Sayyid ‘Umar Basyaiban, Syaikh Ahmad Bajahdab, al-Faqih ash-Shufi ‘Umar Bamakhramah, dan Syaikh Syihabuddin Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman. Ketika berusia dua puluh tujuh tahun, beliau pindah ke Desa ‘Inat dan bermukim di sana sebagai dai yang mengajak kepada Allah. Beliau memiliki banyak karangan dan qasidah yang istimewa. Banyak yang menimba ilmu darinya, di antaranya putra-putranya yang penuh berkah — ‘Umar al-Mihdhar, al-Husain, dan saudara-saudara mereka — al-Imam Shahibusy Syi‘b Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Habsyi, al-Imam ‘Abdurrahman al-Jifri Shahib Taris, dan Sayyid Yusuf bin ‘Abid al-Hasani al-Maghribi. Mujahadah beliau sangat banyak. Beliau wafat di ‘Inat pada malam Ahad, 27 Dzulhijjah 992 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim bin Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman bin Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf was born in Tarim in 919 AH, and raised there. He was occupied in attaining knowledge and actualizing it. He read the Minhaj of an-Nawawi thrice. He read and perused the Ihya of Imam al-Ghazali forty times. He took from many scholars, including Sayyid Umar Ba Shayban, Shaykh Ahmad Ba Jahdab, the jurist and Sufi Umar Ba Makhramah and Shaykh Shihabuddin Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman. When he reached the age of twenty-seven, he moved to the village of Inat and remained there as a caller to Allah. He authored many books and unique poems. Many took from him, including his blessed children Umar al-Mihdhar, al-Husayn and the rest of the brothers, and Imam Sahib al-Shi'b Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Habashi, Imam Abdur Rahman al-Jifri Sahib Tarees and Sayyid Yusuf bin Abid al-Hasani al-Maghribi. His acts of spiritual struggle were many. He passed away in Inat on Saturday night, the 27th of Dhul Hijjah in 992 AH.

passages.sub: Shaykh al-Husayn bin Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim
passages.ar: هو الإمام الشيخ الحسين بن الشيخ أبي بكر بن سالم، وُلد بعينات، وصحب أباه الشيخ أبي بكر ولازمه في سائر الأوقات في حضره وسفره وخلفه في منصبه، واشتغلَ بالعلوم الشرعية، واعتنى بعلوم الصوفية لا سيما الكتب الغزالية، وجدّ في الطاعات، وسار على سيرة سيد السادات، وأخذ عن علماء عصره، وصحبه، وانتفع به خلقٌ كثير، وكان رافضًا للدنيا مُجانبًا لمِن يَخُوضُ في أمرها، وله كرامات كثيرة وأحوال منيرة، توفي بعينات سنة ١٠٤٤هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmusy-Syaikhul-Husain bin asy-Syaikh Abî Bakr bin Sâlim, wulida bi-`Înât, wa shahiba abâhusy-Syaikh Abî Bakr wa lâzamahû fî sâ'iril-auqâti fî hadharihî wa safarihî wa khalafahû fî manshabih, wasytaghala bil-`ulûmisy-syar`iyyah, wa`tanâ bi`ulûmish-shûfiyyati lâ siyyamal-kutubil-ghazâliyyah, wa jadda fith-thâ`ât, wa sâra `alâ sîrati sayyidis-sâdât, wa akhadza `an `ulamâ'i `ashrih, wa shahibah, wantafa`a bihî khalqun katsîr, wa kâna râfidhan lid-dunyâ mujâniban liman yakhûdhu fî amrihâ, wa lahû karâmâtun katsîratun wa ahwâlun munîrah, tuwuffiya bi-`Înât sanata 1044 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam Syaikh al-Husain bin Syaikh Abu Bakar bin Salim. Dilahirkan di ‘Inat, beliau menyertai ayahnya, Syaikh Abu Bakar, dan mendampinginya di sepanjang waktu, baik saat bermukim maupun bepergian, lalu menggantikan kedudukannya. Beliau menyibukkan diri dengan ilmu-ilmu syariat dan menaruh perhatian besar pada ilmu-ilmu tasawuf, khususnya kitab-kitab al-Ghazali. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh dalam ketaatan dan menapaki jalan hidup penghulu para penghulu ﷺ. Beliau menimba ilmu dari para ulama di zamannya, banyak orang menyertainya dan mengambil manfaat darinya. Beliau menolak dunia dan menjauhi orang-orang yang tenggelam dalam urusannya. Beliau memiliki banyak karamah dan hal yang bercahaya. Beliau wafat di ‘Inat pada tahun 1044 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Shaykh al-Husayn bin Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim was born in Inat. He was always with his father, Shaykh Abu Bakr, even when he traveled, and he was his successor. He engaged in seeking knowledge of the Sacred Law and was solicitous about the sciences of Sufism, especially the books of al-Ghazali. He made every effort in acts of obedience, and followed the conduct of the Master of masters ﷺ. He took from the scholars of his time. Many people kept his company and benefitted from him. He would reject the lower world, and avoid those who were engrossed in its affairs. He had many miracles and luminous spiritual states. He passed away in Inat in 1044 AH.

passages.sub: Habib Umar bin Abdur Rahman al-Attas
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب عمر بن عبد الرحمن العطاس، ولد بقرية اللّسك بين عينات وتريم، وحفظ نصف القرآن، ثُم كُفَّ بصره، ونشأ نشأة حسنة في غاية من الجد والاجتهاد في الطاعات، وصحب أباه والحسين بن الشيخ أبي بكر وإخوانه ولازمه وتخرّج به، وأخذ عن جماعة بتريم، ثم رحل إلى وادي عمد وسكن به واشتهر بتلك الناحية، وأقام بحريضة وانتفع به الكثير، منهم أولاده والشيخ علي باراس والإمام عبد الله الحداد، وكان عالمًا عاملًا متواضعًا، داعيًا إلى الله على بصيرة، وله أحوال كبيرة، توفي بحريضة ليلة الخميس ٢٣ ربيع الثاني سنة ١٠٧٢هـ وقيل ١٠٧٧هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Umar bin `Abdirrahmân al-`Aththâs, wulida biqaryatil-Liski baina `Înât wa Tarîm, wa hafizha nishfal-Qur'ân, tsumma kuffa basharuh, wa nasya'a nasy'atan hasanatan fî ghâyatin minal-jiddi wal-ijtihâdi fith-thâ`ât, wa shahiba abâhu wal-Husain bin asy-Syaikh Abî Bakr wa ikhwânahû wa lâzamahû wa takharraja bih, wa akhadza `an jamâ`atin bi-Tarîm, tsumma rahala ilâ Wâdî `Amd wa sakana bihî wasytahara bitilkan-nâhiyah, wa aqâma bi-Huraidhah wantafa`a bihil-katsîr, minhum aulâduhû wasy-Syaikh `Alî Bârâs wal-Imâm `Abdullâhil-Haddâd, wa kâna `âliman `âmilan mutawâdhi`â, dâ`iyan ilallâhi `alâ bashîrah, wa lahû ahwâlun kabîrah, tuwuffiya bi-Huraidhah lailatal-khamîs 23 Rabî`its-Tsânî sanata 1072 H wa qîla 1077 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Umar bin ‘Abdurrahman al-‘Attas. Dilahirkan di Desa al-Lisk, antara ‘Inat dan Tarim, beliau menghafal separuh Al-Qur'an sebelum penglihatannya hilang. Beliau tumbuh dalam didikan yang baik, dengan puncak kesungguhan dan kegigihan dalam ketaatan. Beliau menyertai ayahnya serta al-Husain bin Syaikh Abu Bakar dan saudara-saudaranya, mendampinginya dan lulus dari didikannya, lalu menimba ilmu dari sejumlah ulama Tarim. Kemudian beliau merantau ke Wadi ‘Amd dan menetap di sana hingga masyhur di kawasan itu, lalu bermukim di Huraidhah, dan banyak yang mengambil manfaat darinya — di antaranya putra-putranya, Syaikh ‘Ali Baras, dan al-Imam ‘Abdullah al-Haddad. Beliau seorang alim yang mengamalkan ilmunya, tawaduk, dan dai yang mengajak kepada Allah di atas bashirah, serta memiliki hal-hal spiritual yang besar. Beliau wafat di Huraidhah pada malam Kamis, 23 Rabiuts Tsani 1072 H (pendapat lain 1077 H).
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Umar bin Abdur Rahman al-Attas was born in the village of al-Lisk, between Inat and Tarim. He memorized half of the Quran, and then lost his sight. He had a beautiful upbringing, striving his utmost in acts of obedience. He kept the company of his father and al-Husayn bin Shaykh Abu Bakr, who he adhered to and was educated by. He also kept the company of al-Husayn's brothers. He took from several scholars in Tarim. He then traveled to Wadi Amd and lived there and became well-known in that region. He resided in Huraydhah and many benefited from him, including his children, and Shaykh Ali Ba Ras and Imam Abdullah al-Haddad. He was a scholar who acted on his knowledge, and was humble. He was a caller to Allah with clear insight. He had great spiritual states. He passed away in Huraydhah on Wednesday night 23rd Rabi al-Thani in 1072 AH (1661). Another opinion is that the year was 1077 AH.

passages.sub: Habib Abdullah bin Alawi al-Haddad
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب عبد الله بن علوي الحداد، ولد بتريم سنة ١٠٤٤هـ وحفظ القرآن العظيم ونشأ بها على طاعة الله، وكُفَّ بصره في أيامِ طفولته فعوضه الله ببصيرة ثاقبة، اجتهد في تحصيل العلوم وصحب العديد من الأكابر كالإمام عمر العطاس وغيره، وأخذ عن الإمام محمد بن علوي السقاف نزيل مكة بالمُكاتبة، وجدّ في سائر الطاعات مستمرًا مع الإقبال حتى نال ما نال مما لا يخطر على بال، وهو قطب الدعوة والإرشاد، انتفع به الجم الغفير، ونفعه بلغَ أقصى العالم، له أوراد وأحزاب مباركة مقتبسة من هدي النبوة، وله مؤلفات نافعة، وديوان عظيم المقدار، مناقبه مشهورة، وأفرده غير واحد بالترجمة، توفي سنة ١١٣٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Alawî al-Haddâd, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 1044 H wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîma wa nasya'a bihâ `alâ thâ`atillâh, wa kuffa basharuhû fî ayyâmi thufûlatihî fa`awwadhahullâhu bibashîratin tsâqibah, ijtahada fî tahshîlil-`ulûmi wa shahibal-`adîda minal-akâbiri kal-Imâm `Umaril-`Aththâsi wa ghairih, wa akhadza `anil-Imâm Muhammad bin `Alawî as-Saqqâf nazîli Makkata bil-mukâtabah, wa jadda fî sâ'irith-thâ`âti mustamirran ma`al-iqbâli hattâ nâla mâ nâla mimmâ lâ yakhthuru `alâ bâl, wa huwa quthbud-da`wati wal-irsyâd, intafa`a bihil-jammul-ghafîr, wa naf`uhû balagha aqshal-`âlam, lahû aurâdun wa ahzâbun mubârakatun muqtabasatun min hadyin-nubuwwah, wa lahû mu'allafâtun nâfi`ah, wa dîwânun `azhîmul-miqdâr, manâqibuhû masyhûrah, wa afradahû ghairu wâhidin bit-tarjamah, tuwuffiya sanata 1132 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Alawi al-Haddad. Dilahirkan di Tarim pada tahun 1044 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan tumbuh besar di sana dalam ketaatan kepada Allah. Penglihatannya hilang di masa kanak-kanak, namun Allah menggantinya dengan bashirah (mata hati) yang tajam menembus. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh menuntut ilmu dan menyertai banyak ulama besar seperti al-Imam ‘Umar al-‘Attas dan lainnya, serta berguru kepada al-Imam Muhammad bin ‘Alawi as-Saqqaf yang bermukim di Makkah melalui surat-menyurat. Beliau terus bersungguh-sungguh dalam segala ketaatan dengan penghadapan penuh kepada Allah hingga meraih apa yang tak terbayangkan. Beliaulah Quthbud Da‘wah wal Irsyad (poros dakwah dan bimbingan); sangat banyak orang mengambil manfaat darinya, dan manfaatnya mencapai ujung-ujung dunia. Beliau menyusun wirid dan hizib penuh berkah yang diambil dari petunjuk kenabian, memiliki karangan-karangan yang bermanfaat dan diwan yang agung nilainya. Manaqibnya masyhur, dan tidak sedikit ulama yang menulis biografi khusus tentangnya. Beliau wafat pada tahun 1132 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abdullah bin Alawi al-Haddad was born in Tarim in 1044 AH, and raised there upon obedience to Allah. He memorized the Glorious Quran. He lost his sight in childhood, but Allah recompensed him with penetrating inner sight. He strove to attain knowledge and kept the company of many senior scholars, such as Imam Umar al-Attas, and others. He took from Imam Muhammad bin Alawi as-Saqqaf who lived in Makkah, by means of correspondence. He made every effort in all acts of obedience, with complete turning to Allah, until he attained the unimaginable. He is the Qutb (Axial Pole) of Calling to Allah and Guidance. Numerous people benefitted from him. His benefit reached the furthest ends of the world. He compiled blessed awrad (litanies) and ahzab that are taken from the Prophetic guidance. He authored beneficial books and a great diwan (compilation of poetry). His virtues are well-known. A number of people have written books devoted to discussing his life. He passed away in 1132 AH (1720).

passages.sub: Habib Ahmad bin Zayn al-Habashi
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب أحمد بن زين الحبشي، ولد بمدينة الغُرفة من مُدن حضرموت سنة ١٠٦٩هـ ونشأ بها وتربّى بأبيه، فحفظ القرآن العظيم، وجدَّ واجتهد من صغره في التحصيل والعبادة، ومن حين صباه وقلبه معلّقٌ بمولاه، وأخذ عن عمه عيدروس والفقيه محمد باجمّال، ورحل إلى تريم واتصل بالإمام الحداد وامتزج معه امتزاجًا كُلّيا، وأخذَ أيضًا عن غيرهم حتى فاق أقرانه، وانتفعَ به خلقٌ كثير، وكان داعيًا إلى الله بحاله ومقاله، وبنى عددًا من المساجد بحضرموت، وكان صاحب ورع وكشف جلي، وله تآليف عديدة، توفي بالحوطة يوم الجمعة ١٩ شعبان سنة ١١٤٤هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Ahmad bin Zainil-Habasyî, wulida bimadînatil-Ghurfati min mudun Hadhramauta sanata 1069 H wa nasya'a bihâ wa tarabbâ bi'abîh, fahafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa jadda wajtahada min shighrihî fit-tahshîli wal-`ibâdah, wa min hîni shibâhu wa qalbuhû mu`allaqun bimaulâh, wa akhadza `an `ammihî `Aidarûs wal-Faqîh Muhammad Bâjammâl, wa rahala ilâ Tarîm wattashala bil-Imâmil-Haddâd wamtazaja ma`ahumtizâjan kulliyyâ, wa akhadza aidhan `an ghairihim hattâ fâqa aqrânah, wantafa`a bihî khalqun katsîr, wa kâna dâ`iyan ilallâhi bihâlihî wa maqâlih, wa banâ `adadan minal-masâjidi bi-Hadhramaut, wa kâna shâhiba wara`in wa kasyfin jalî, wa lahû ta'âlîfu `adîdah, tuwuffiya bil-Hauthati yaumal-jum`ah 19 Sya`bân sanata 1144 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Zain al-Habsyi. Dilahirkan di kota al-Ghurfah, salah satu kota di Hadhramaut, pada tahun 1069 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana dalam didikan ayahnya hingga hafal Al-Qur'an yang agung. Sejak kecil beliau bersungguh-sungguh dalam menuntut ilmu dan beribadah, dan sejak masa mudanya hatinya telah terpaut kepada Tuhannya. Beliau menimba ilmu dari pamannya, ‘Aydarus, dan al-Faqih Muhammad Bajammal, lalu merantau ke Tarim dan terhubung dengan al-Imam al-Haddad hingga menyatu dengannya secara total; beliau juga belajar dari ulama lainnya hingga mengungguli rekan-rekannya. Banyak orang mengambil manfaat darinya. Beliau berdakwah kepada Allah dengan keadaan dan ucapannya, membangun sejumlah masjid di Hadhramaut, serta dikenal wara‘ dan memiliki kasyaf yang terang. Beliau memiliki banyak karangan. Beliau wafat di al-Hauthah pada hari Jumat, 19 Sya‘ban 1144 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Zayn al-Habashi was born in the town of al-Ghurfah in Hadhramawt in 1069 AH, and raised there. He came to imitate his father in all his states and actions. He memorized the Glorious Quran, and strove his utmost from childhood to attain knowledge and worship. From early childhood, his heart was attached to his Lord. He took from his paternal uncle Aydarus and the jurist Muhammad Ba Jammal. He traveled to Tarim and established a complete connection with Imam al-Haddad. He also took from others and surpassed his peers. Many benefitted from him. He was a caller to Allah with his spiritual state and words. He built a number of mosques in Hadhramawt. He was scrupulous and possessed clear spiritual unveiling. He authored several books. He passed away in al-Hawtah on Friday, the 19th of Shaban in 1144 AH.

passages.sub: Habib Abdur Rahman bin Abdillah Balfaqih
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن أحمد بلفقيه، ولد بتريم وحفظ القرآن العظيم، ومكث يطلب العلوم طويلًا، أخذ عن والده وعن جده الإمام محمد بن عبد الرحمن العيدروس وعن الإمام الحداد وغيرهم، أثنى عليه الإمام الحداد بقوله: "والله ما في الأكوان مثل عبد الرحمن" وكان ممن خصه الله بالعلم الظاهر والباطن، وكان يقول:
"إن الله منحني ثلاثين عِلمًا وجدتُ الناس جميعًا اليوم يتعاطون في أربعة عشر عِلمًا وستة عشر ما سُئلتُ عنها"، له مؤلفات نافعة وديوان شعر منه قصيدة الرّشفات المشهورة، توفي بتريم ليلة الأربعاء ٢٦ جمادى الآخرة سنة ١١٦٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Abdurrahmân bin `Abdillâh bin Ahmad Balfaqîh, wulida bi-Tarîm wa hafizhal-Qur'ânal-`azhîm, wa makatsa yathlubul-`ulûma thawîlâ, akhadza `an wâlidihî wa `an jaddihil-Imâm Muhammad bin `Abdirrahmân al-`Aidarûs wa `anil-Imâmil-Haddâdi wa ghairihim, atsnâ `alaihil-Imâmul-Haddâdu biqaulih: "wallâhi mâ fil-akwâni mitslu `Abdirrahmân" wa kâna mimman khashshahullâhu bil-`ilmizh-zhâhiri wal-bâthin, wa kâna yaqûl: "innallâha manahanî tsalâtsîna `ilman wajadtun-nâsa jamî`anil-yauma yata`âthauna fî arba`ata `asyara `ilman wa sittata `asyara mâ su'iltu `anhâ", lahû mu'allafâtun nâfi`atun wa dîwânu syi`rin minhu qashîdatur-Rasyafâtil-masyhûrah, tuwuffiya bi-Tarîm lailatal-arbi`â' 26 Jumâdal-Âkhirah sanata 1162 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Abdurrahman bin ‘Abdullah bin Ahmad Bilfaqih. Dilahirkan di Tarim, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an yang agung dan lama menekuni menuntut ilmu. Beliau berguru kepada ayahnya, kakeknya — al-Imam Muhammad bin ‘Abdurrahman al-‘Aydarus — al-Imam al-Haddad, dan yang lainnya. Al-Imam al-Haddad memujinya dengan berkata, “Demi Allah, tidak ada di alam ini yang seperti ‘Abdurrahman.” Beliau termasuk yang Allah istimewakan dengan ilmu zahir dan batin. Beliau pernah berkata, “Sesungguhnya Allah menganugerahiku tiga puluh ilmu; kudapati semua orang hari ini hanya menekuni empat belas ilmu, sedangkan enam belas lainnya tidak pernah aku ditanya tentangnya.” Beliau memiliki karangan-karangan yang bermanfaat dan diwan syair, di antaranya qasidah ar-Rasyafat yang masyhur. Beliau wafat di Tarim pada malam Rabu, 26 Jumadil Akhir 1162 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abdur Rahman bin Abdillah bin Ahmad Balfaqih was born in Tarim. He memorized the Glorious Quran and spent a long time seeking knowledge. He took from his father, and grandfather, al-Imam Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman al-Aydarus, and Imam al-Haddad and others. Imam al-Haddad praised him, saying, “I swear, there is no one in the universe like Abdur Rahman.” He was of those whom Allah had favoured with inner and outer knowledge. He said that Allah had blessed him with the mastery of thirty sciences but that the people of his time only studied fourteen of these sciences. He said, “There are sixteen sciences that no one has ever asked me about.” He wrote beneficial works and has a diwan (compilation of poetry), which includes the famous poem, Rashafat. He passed away in Tarim on a Tuesday night, 26th Jumad al-Aakhirah, 1162 AH (1749).

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Zayn bin Sumayt
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب محمد بن زين بن سميط، ولد بتريم وأخذ عن علماء عصره، وأجلهم الإمام الحداد الذي كان جُلُّ انتفاعه به، وانطرح عليه انطراحًا كُليًّا ولازمه، وألّفَ في ترجمته كتاب (غاية القصد والمراد)، وأخذ عن الحبيب أحمد بن زين الحبشي وألّف في ترجمته كتاب (قرة العين)، كان عابدًا ورعًا زاهدًا، له اليد الطولى في الدعوة إلى الله في شبام التي رحل إليها، وكان ورده اليومي بداية أمره جزءًا من (الإحياء)، انتفع به كثير، منهم الحبيب سقاف بن محمد السقاف والحبيب عبد الله بن علوي الحبشي والحبيب حامد بن عمر وغيرهم، توفي بشبام في ربيع الأول سنة ١١٧٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Muhammad bin Zain bin Sumaith, wulida bi-Tarîm wa akhadza `an `ulamâ'i `ashrih, wa ajalluhumul-Imâmul-Haddâdul-ladzî kâna jullun-tifâ`ihî bih, wantharaha `alaihin-thirâhan kulliyyan wa lâzamah, wa allafa fî tarjamatihî kitâb (Ghâyatil-Qashdi wal-Murâd), wa akhadza `anil-Habîb Ahmad bin Zainil-Habasyî wa allafa fî tarjamatihî kitâb (Qurratil-`Ain), kâna `âbidan wari`an zâhidâ, lahul-yadith-thûlâ fid-da`wati ilallâhi fî Syibâmil-latî rahala ilaihâ, wa kâna wirduhul-yaumî bidâyata amrihî juz'an min (al-Ihyâ'), intafa`a bihî katsîr, minhumul-Habîb Saqqâf bin Muhammad as-Saqqâf wal-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Alawî al-Habasyî wal-Habîb Hâmid bin `Umar wa ghairuhum, tuwuffiya bi-Syibâm fî Rabî`il-Awwal sanata 1172 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Muhammad bin Zain bin Sumaith. Dilahirkan di Tarim, beliau menimba ilmu dari para ulama di zamannya; yang paling agung adalah al-Imam al-Haddad, yang darinya beliau memperoleh manfaat terbesar, kepadanya beliau menyerahkan diri sepenuhnya dan terus mendampinginya, hingga menulis biografinya dalam kitab Ghayatul Qashd wal Murad. Beliau juga berguru kepada al-Habib Ahmad bin Zain al-Habsyi dan menulis biografinya dalam kitab Qurratul ‘Ain. Beliau seorang ahli ibadah yang wara‘ dan zahid, memiliki andil besar dalam dakwah kepada Allah di kota Syibam, tempat beliau berhijrah. Wirid hariannya pada awal perjalanannya adalah membaca satu juz dari kitab Ihya'. Banyak yang mengambil manfaat darinya, di antaranya al-Habib Saqqaf bin Muhammad as-Saqqaf, al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Alawi al-Habsyi, al-Habib Hamid bin ‘Umar, dan lainnya. Beliau wafat di Syibam pada bulan Rabiul Awwal 1172 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Muhammad bin Zayn bin Sumayt was born in Tarim. He took from the scholars of his time, the greatest of whom was Imam al-Haddad, from whom he benefited the most and clung to. He wrote a biography about him, “Ghayat al-Qasd wal Murad.” He also took from Habib Ahmad bin Zayn al-Habashi, about whom he wrote a biography, “Qurrat al-Ayn.” He was a scrupulous worshipper whose heart was detached from the world. He had great influence in calling to Allah in Shibam where he migrated to. Among his initial daily litanies when he was young was a part of the Ihya. Many benefitted from him, including Habib Saqqaf bin Muhammad as-Saqqaf, Habib Abdullah bin Alawi al-Habashi, Habib Hamid bin Umar, and others. He passed away in Shibam in Rabi al-Awwal, 1172 AH (1758).

passages.sub: Habib Hamid bin Umar Ba Alawi
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب حامد بن عمر بن حامد باعلوي، ولد بتريم ونشأ بها، وأخذ علوم القوم في صِغره ثم أخذته الأحوال والمقامات في كِبَرِه، تأدب بأبيه ولازمه وكان على غاية من الأدب فقد كان لا يطرد الذباب عن وجهه بحضرة والده، وكان لا يولي والديه ظهره، وأخذ عن خاله علامة الدنيا الحبيب عبد الرحمن بلفقيه وغيرهم، وكان مجتهدًا في العبادة ولا يفتر عن ذكر الله، وكان متغافلًا عن الدنيا مشتغلًا بإصلاح نفسه، أخذَ العلمَ عنهُ كثير، وله القصة المشهورة عند زيارة جده المصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم، توفي ليلة الخميس ١٤ أو ١٥ شعبان سنة ١٢٠٩هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Hâmid bin `Umar bin Hâmid Bâ`alawî, wulida bi-Tarîm wa nasya'a bihâ, wa akhadza `ulûmal-qaumi fî shighrihî tsumma akhadzat-hul-ahwâlu wal-maqâmâtu fî kibarih, ta'addaba bi'abîhi wa lâzamahû wa kâna `alâ ghâyatin minal-adabi faqad kâna lâ yathrududz-dzubâba `an wajhihî bihadhrati wâlidih, wa kâna lâ yuwallî wâlidaihi zhahrah, wa akhadza `an khâlihî `allâmatid-dunyal-Habîb `Abdirrahmân Balfaqîh wa ghairihim, wa kâna mujtahidan fil-`ibâdati wa lâ yafturu `an dzikrillâh, wa kâna mutaghâfilan `anid-dunyâ musytaghilan bi'ishlâhi nafsih, akhadzal-`ilma `anhu katsîr, wa lahul-qishshatul-masyhûratu `inda ziyârati jaddihil-Mushthafâ shallallâhu `alaihi wa sallam, tuwuffiya lailatal-khamîs 14 au 15 Sya`bân sanata 1209 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Hamid bin ‘Umar bin Hamid Ba ‘Alawi. Dilahirkan di Tarim dan tumbuh besar di sana, beliau mengambil ilmu kaum sufi sejak kecil, lalu hal dan maqam spiritual menghampirinya di masa tuanya. Beliau mengambil adab dari ayahnya dan terus mendampinginya dengan puncak adab — beliau tidak berani mengusir lalat dari wajahnya di hadapan ayahnya dan tidak pernah membelakangi kedua orang tuanya. Beliau juga menimba ilmu dari pamannya (saudara ibunya), ‘Allamatud-Dunya al-Habib ‘Abdurrahman Bilfaqih, dan yang lainnya. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh dalam ibadah dan tak pernah kendur dari dzikir kepada Allah, berpaling dari dunia dan sibuk memperbaiki dirinya. Banyak yang mengambil ilmu darinya. Beliau memiliki kisah masyhur saat menziarahi datuknya, al-Musthafa ﷺ. Beliau wafat pada malam Kamis, 14 atau 15 Sya‘ban 1209 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Hamid bin Umar bin Hamid Ba Alawi was born in Tarim, and was raised there. He took the knowledge of the Folk when he was young, and then spiritual states and stations took him when he was old. He imitated his father in all his states and actions, adhered to him, and had the utmost good manners with him. He would not even move his hand to drive a fly away from his face in the presence of his father. He would never turn his back to his parents. He took from his maternal uncle, Allamat ad-Dunya (the greatest scholar on the earth) Habib Abdur Rahman Balfaqih, as well as others. He would strive greatly in worship, and never cease making remembrance of Allah. He disregarded the dunya, and was occupied with rectifying himself. Many took knowledge from him. There is a well known story about him when he visited his grandfather, the Chosen One, peace and blessings be upon him. He passed away on a Wednesday night, on the 14th or 15th Sha'ban, 1209 AH (1795).

passages.sub: Habib Umar bin Saqqaf as-Saqqaf
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب عمر بن سقاف بن محمد الصافي السقاف، ولد بسيؤون سنة ١١٥٤هـ، وحفظ القرآن صغيرًا، وكان كثير التحدث مع معلمه في علوم التفسير وكلام الصوفية وأذواقهم، وأخذ العلم عن أئمة منهم والده الحبيب سقاف وجده الحبيب علي بن عبد الله السقاف والحبيب حسن بن عبد الله الحداد والحبيب حامد بن عمر حامد وغيرهم، وبرع في تحصيل العلوم وكان معروفًا بالذكاء الخارق والفهم الواسع وقوة الحفظ وسعة الاطلاع، وكان مجتهدًا في اتباع الكتاب والسنة، تصدّر للدروس والمجالس العلمية للدعوة والإرشاد ونشر العلم، وهو شيخ المتأخرين وتلقّى العلم عنه كثير، منهم إخوانه وأولاده وغيرهم، له مؤلفات نافعة وديوان شعر رائق، توفي بسيؤون ٢ شوال سنة ١٢١٦هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Umar bin Saqqâf bin Muhammad ash-Shâfî as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Saiwûn sanata 1154 H, wa hafizhal-Qur'âna shaghîrâ, wa kâna katsîrat-tahadduts ma`a mu`allimihî fî `ulûmit-tafsîri wa kalâmish-shûfiyyati wa adzwâqihim, wa akhadzal-`ilma `an a'immatin minhum wâliduhul-Habîb Saqqâf wa jadduhul-Habîb `Alî bin `Abdillâh as-Saqqâf wal-Habîb Hasan bin `Abdillâh al-Haddâd wal-Habîb Hâmid bin `Umar Hâmid wa ghairuhum, wa bara`a fî tahshîlil-`ulûmi wa kâna ma`rûfan bidz-dzakâ'il-khâriqi wal-fahmil-wâsi`i wa quwwatil-hifzhi wa sa`atith-thilâ`, wa kâna mujtahidan fittibâ`il-Kitâbi was-Sunnah, tashaddara lid-durûsi wal-majâlisil-`ilmiyyati lid-da`wati wal-irsyâdi wa nasyril-`ilm, wa huwa syaikhul-muta'akhkhirîn wa talaqqal-`ilma `anhu katsîr, minhum ikhwânuhû wa aulâduhû wa ghairuhum, lahû mu'allafâtun nâfi`atun wa dîwânu syi`rin râ'iq, tuwuffiya bi-Saiwûn 2 Syawwâl sanata 1216 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Umar bin Saqqaf bin Muhammad ash-Shafi as-Saqqaf. Dilahirkan di Seiwun pada tahun 1154 H, beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an sejak kecil. Beliau banyak berbincang dengan gurunya mengenai ilmu tafsir, ucapan para sufi, dan cita rasa spiritual mereka. Beliau menimba ilmu dari para imam, di antaranya ayahnya, al-Habib Saqqaf; kakeknya, al-Habib ‘Ali bin ‘Abdullah as-Saqqaf; al-Habib Hasan bin ‘Abdullah al-Haddad; al-Habib Hamid bin ‘Umar Hamid; dan lainnya. Beliau piawai dalam menuntut ilmu, dikenal dengan kecerdasan luar biasa, pemahaman yang luas, hafalan yang kuat, dan wawasan yang lapang, serta bersungguh-sungguh dalam mengikuti Al-Qur'an dan Sunnah. Beliau memimpin pelajaran-pelajaran dan majelis-majelis ilmu untuk dakwah, bimbingan, dan penyebaran ilmu; beliaulah syaikh para ulama muta'akhirin. Banyak yang menerima ilmu darinya, di antaranya saudara-saudara dan putra-putranya. Beliau memiliki karya-karya yang bermanfaat dan diwan syair yang jernih indah. Beliau wafat di Seiwun pada 2 Syawal 1216 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Umar bin Saqqaf bin Muhammad as-Safi as-Saqqaf was born in Seiyun in 1154 AH. He memorized the Quran when he was young. He frequently discussed the sciences of exegesis and the speech of the Sufis and their experiences with his teacher. He took knowledge from Imams, such as his father Habib Saqqaf, his grandfather Habib Ali bin Abdullah as-Saqqaf, Habib Hasan bin Abdullah al-Haddad, Habib Hamid bin Umar Hamid, and others. He surpassed in attaining knowledge and was known for his extraordinary intelligence, vast understanding, powerful memory, and great knowledge. He strove greatly to follow the Book and the Sunnah. He presided over lessons, scholarly gatherings for calling to Allah and guidance, and dissemination of knowledge. He is the Shaykh of those of latter times. Many received knowledge from him, such as his brothers, his children, and others. He wrote beneficial books and a compilation of beautiful poetry. He passed away in Seiyun on the 2nd of Shawwal, 1216 AH (1802).

passages.sub: Habib Ahmad bin Umar bin Sumayt
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب أحمد بن عمر بن زين بن سميط، الداعي إلى الله بحاله ومقاله، ولد بشبام سنة ١١٧٧هـ وتأدب بأبيه وأخذَ عن كثير من العلماء، منهم: والده والحبيب حامد بن عمر والحبيب عمر بن سقاف وغيرهم، كان مجتهدًا في العبادة، ورعًا تقيًّا ناسكًا محافظًا على أنفاسه وأوقاته، انتشر علمه في البلاد وانتفعَ بدعوته الحاضر والباد، له تلامذة كثيرون، من أجلّهم: الحبيب أبوبكر بن عبد الله العطاس والحبيب عيدروس بن عمر الحبشي، وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يحبه كما أخبر بذلك بعض الصالحين في رؤيا وذلك لقيامه بالدعوة إلى الله وخدمة الدين والصدق في ذلك، توفي بشِبام سنة ١٢٥٧ أو ١٢٥٨هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Ahmad bin `Umar bin Zain bin Sumaith, ad-dâ`î ilallâhi bihâlihî wa maqâlih, wulida bi-Syibâm sanata 1177 H wa ta'addaba bi'abîhi wa akhadza `an katsîrin minal-`ulamâ', minhum: wâliduhû wal-Habîb Hâmid bin `Umar wal-Habîb `Umar bin Saqqâf wa ghairuhum, kâna mujtahidan fil-`ibâdah, wari`an taqiyyan nâsikan muhâfizhan `alâ anfâsihî wa auqâtih, intasyara `ilmuhû fil-bilâdi wantafa`a bida`watihil-hâdhiru wal-bâd, lahû talâmidzatun katsîrûn, min ajallihim: al-Habîb Abûbakr bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâs wal-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umaril-Habasyî, wa kânan-Nabiyyu shallallâhu `alaihi wa sallam yuhibbuhû kamâ akhbara bidzâlika ba`dhush-shâlihîna fî ru'yâ wa dzâlika liqiyâmihî bid-da`wati ilallâhi wa khidmatid-dîni wash-shidqi fî dzâlik, tuwuffiya bi-Syibâm sanata 1257 au 1258 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Umar bin Zain bin Sumaith, seorang dai yang mengajak kepada Allah dengan keadaan dan ucapannya. Dilahirkan di Syibam pada tahun 1177 H, beliau mengambil adab dari ayahnya dan menimba ilmu dari banyak ulama, di antaranya ayahnya sendiri, al-Habib Hamid bin ‘Umar, al-Habib ‘Umar bin Saqqaf, dan lainnya. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh dalam ibadah, wara‘, bertakwa, tekun beribadah, serta menjaga setiap napas dan waktunya. Ilmunya tersebar di berbagai negeri, dan dakwahnya dirasakan manfaatnya oleh penduduk kota maupun pedalaman. Beliau memiliki banyak murid, yang paling agung di antaranya al-Habib Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas dan al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar al-Habsyi. Nabi ﷺ mencintainya, sebagaimana dikabarkan sebagian orang shalih dalam mimpi — hal itu karena tegaknya beliau dalam dakwah kepada Allah, melayani agama, dan kejujurannya dalam semua itu. Beliau wafat di Syibam pada tahun 1257 atau 1258 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Umar bin Zayn bin Sumayt, the caller to Allah through his state and words, was born in Shibam in 1177 AH. He came to imitate his father in all his states and actions. He took from many scholars, such as his father, Habib Hamid bin Umar, Habib Umar bin Saqqaf and others. He would strive greatly in worship. He was scrupulous, mindful of Allah, a devotee, and made use of every breath and moment of his. His knowledge spread throughout the land and people everywhere benefited from his dawah. He had many students, the greatest of whom were Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas and Habib Aydarus bin Umar al-Habashi. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, loves him, as some of the righteous informed from their dreams, which is because he undertook the call to Allah, served the religion, and was sincere in doing so. He passed away in Shibam in 1257 or 1258 AH.

passages.sub: Habib Abdullah bin Husayn bin Tahir
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب عبد الله بن حسين بن طاهر، ولد بتريم سنة ١١٩١هـ، ونشأ بها، أخذ العلم عن أخيه الحبيب طاهر والحبيب أحمد بن سميط وغيرهم، وشيخ فتحه الإمام الحبيب عمر بن سقاف، وكان متأدبًا مع أخيه، فكان لا يطلع سطحَ دارٍ أخوه تحته، ولا يتقدم عليه حتى في صباه، تخلّى عن المهلكات، وتحلّى بالمنجيات، ووصفهُ:
(الإحياء)، وزيادة، كما قال عنه الحبيب عبد الله بن عمر بن يحي، وكان كثير الذكر لله تاليًا لكتابه، متخلقًا بالأخلاق النبوية، وكان محافظًا على أوقاته شديد المحافظة، وانتفع به خلقٌ كثير، له مؤلفات، ووصايا نافعة، وقصائد كثيرة، توفي بالمسيلة في ١٧ ربيع الثاني ١٢٧٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin Husain bin Thâhir, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 1191 H, wa nasya'a bihâ, akhadzal-`ilma `an akhîhil-Habîb Thâhir wal-Habîb Ahmad bin Sumaith wa ghairihim, wa syaikhu fat-hihil-Imâmul-Habîb `Umar bin Saqqâf, wa kâna muta'addiban ma`a akhîh, fakâna lâ yathla`u sath-ha dârin akhûhu tahtah, wa lâ yataqaddamu `alaihi hattâ fî shibâh, takhallâ `anil-muhlikât, wa tahallâ bil-munjiyât, wa washfuhû: (al-Ihyâ'), wa ziyâdah, kamâ qâla `anhul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Umar bin Yahyâ, wa kâna katsîradz-dzikri lillâhi tâliyan likitâbih, mutakhalliqan bil-akhlâqin-nabawiyyah, wa kâna muhâfizhan `alâ auqâtihî syadîdal-muhâfazhah, wantafa`a bihî khalqun katsîr, lahû mu'allafâtun, wa washâyâ nâfi`atun, wa qashâ'idu katsîrah, tuwuffiya bil-Masîlah fî 17 Rabî`its-Tsânî 1272 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin Husain bin Thahir. Dilahirkan di Tarim pada tahun 1191 H dan tumbuh besar di sana, beliau mengambil ilmu dari kakaknya, al-Habib Thahir, al-Habib Ahmad bin Sumaith, dan lainnya; adapun guru futuh (pembuka spiritual)-nya adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Umar bin Saqqaf. Beliau sangat beradab kepada kakaknya: tidak mau naik ke atap rumah bila kakaknya berada di bawahnya, dan tidak pernah mendahuluinya, bahkan sejak masa kecilnya. Beliau melepaskan diri dari perkara yang membinasakan dan menghiasi diri dengan yang menyelamatkan; sifat beliau adalah apa yang termuat dalam kitab Ihya' — bahkan lebih — sebagaimana dikatakan al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar bin Yahya. Beliau banyak berdzikir kepada Allah dan membaca kitab-Nya, berakhlak dengan akhlak nabawi, serta sangat ketat menjaga waktunya. Banyak orang mengambil manfaat darinya. Beliau memiliki karangan-karangan, wasiat-wasiat yang bermanfaat, dan banyak qasidah. Beliau wafat di al-Masilah pada 17 Rabiuts Tsani 1272 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abdullah bin Husayn bin Tahir was born in Tarim in 1191 AH and raised there. He took knowledge from his brother Habib Tahir and Habib Ahmad bin Sumayt and others. The shaykh from whom he received his opening was Imam Habib Umar bin Saqqaf. He had immense respect for his older brother. In their childhood, in their house, he would not go up to a higher storey if his brother was below. He would never walk ahead of him. He was free of all destructive traits and attained all praiseworthy traits which save one from destruction. As Habib Abdullah bin Umar bin Yahya said of him: “His attributes are those that are contained in the Ihya and more.” He would make abundant remembrance of Allah and recite His Book, and he adopted the Prophetic character. He was extremely mindful of every moment of his. Many benefitted from him. He wrote beneficial books and counsels, and composed many poems. He passed away in al-Masilah on the 17th of Rabi at-Thani in 1272 AH (1855).

passages.sub: Habib al-Hasan bin Salih al-Bahr al-Jifri
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب الحسن بن صالح البحر الجفري، ولد بالحوطة سنة ١١٩١هـ، أخذ العلم والطريق عن أئمة أعلام، منهم الحبيب عمر بن سقاف وهو شيخ فَتْحِه، وعن أخيه الحبيب علوي بن سقاف والحبيب شيخ الجفري، كان إمامًا جامعًا لأنواع الكمالات، أخلاقه أخلاق النبيين، يأوي إليه الفقراء والمساكين، مستقيمًا على المنهج القويم، ويُقال له: سيد الوادي، ألّف كتابًا في صفة صلاة المقربين، مناقبه شهيرة، وله كرامات كثيرة، أخذ عنه كثير، منهم الحبيب أبوبكر بن عبد الله العطاس والحبيب عيدروس بن عمر الحبشي، توفي في ذي القعدة سنة ١٢٧٣هـ بقرية ذي أصبَحْ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîbul-Hasan bin Shâlih al-Bahr al-Jifrî, wulida bil-Hauthati sanata 1191 H, akhadzal-`ilma wath-tharîqa `an a'immatin a`lâm, minhumul-Habîb `Umar bin Saqqâf wa huwa syaikhu fat-hih, wa `an akhîhil-Habîb `Alawî bin Saqqâf wal-Habîb Syaikh al-Jifrî, kâna imâman jâmi`an li'anwâ`il-kamâlât, akhlâquhû akhlâqun-nabiyyîn, ya'wî ilaihil-fuqarâ'u wal-masâkîn, mustaqîman `alal-manhajil-qawîm, wa yuqâlu lah: sayyidul-wâdî, allafa kitâban fî shifati shalâtil-muqarrabîn, manâqibuhû syahîrah, wa lahû karâmâtun katsîrah, akhadza `anhu katsîr, minhumul-Habîb Abûbakr bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâs wal-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umaril-Habasyî, tuwuffiya fî Dzil-Qa`dah sanata 1273 H biqaryati Dzî Ashbah.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Hasan bin Shalih al-Bahr al-Jifri. Dilahirkan di al-Hauthah pada tahun 1191 H, beliau mengambil ilmu dan thariqah dari para imam terkemuka, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Umar bin Saqqaf — guru futuh-nya — serta kakaknya, al-Habib ‘Alawi bin Saqqaf, dan al-Habib Syaikh al-Jifri. Beliau adalah imam yang menghimpun berbagai kesempurnaan; akhlaknya laksana akhlak para nabi, kaum fakir dan miskin berlindung kepadanya, dan beliau istiqamah di atas manhaj yang lurus, hingga dijuluki Sayyidul Wadi (pemimpin lembah). Beliau menulis sebuah kitab tentang sifat shalat kaum muqarrabin. Manaqibnya masyhur dan karamahnya banyak. Banyak yang menimba ilmu darinya, di antaranya al-Habib Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas dan al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar al-Habsyi. Beliau wafat pada bulan Dzulqa‘dah 1273 H di Desa Dzi Ashbah.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib al-Hasan bin Salih al-Bahr al-Jifri was born in al-Hawtah in 1191 AH. He took knowledge and the path from Imams who were luminaries, such as Habib Umar bin Saqqaf, from whom he received his opening, his brother Habib Alawi bin Saqqaf and Habib Shaykh al-Jifri. He was an Imam who possessed various perfect qualities. His character was that of the Prophets. The poor and the needy would turn to him for accommodation. He was steadfast on the straight path. He was called, “Master of the [Hadramawt] Valley.” He wrote a book describing the salah of those drawn near to Allah. His virtues are well known. He had many miracles. Many took from him, such as Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas and Habib Aydarus bin Umar al-Habashi. He passed away in Dhul Qadah in 1273 AH (1857), in the village of Dhi Asbah.

passages.sub: Habib Muhsin bin Alawi as-Saqqaf
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب محسن بن علوي بن سقاف السقاف، ولد بسيؤون سنة ١٢١١هـ، وتربى بأبيه وتعيّن عليه القضاء بعده وهو دون الرابعة والعشرين، كان عالمًا عاملًا زاهدًا ورعًا تقيًّا، وكان صاحب استقامة واتباع للكتاب والسنة، وكان ذا اتساعٍ في العلوم، أخذ عن علماء عصره، منهم الحبيب عبد الله بن حسين بن طاهر وأخيه طاهر، وعقد الأخوة والعهد على الدعوة والتآزر فيها مع الحبيب محمد بن حسين الحبشي والحبيب عبد الله بن عمر بن يحي، وانتفع به خلقٌ كثير، منهم الحبيب عيدروس بن عمر الحبشي والحبيب أحمد بن حسن العطاس، توفي بسيؤون يوم الاثنين ٥ رمضان سنة ١٢٩٠هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Muhsin bin `Alawî bin Saqqâf as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Saiwûn sanata 1211 H, wa tarabbâ bi'abîhi wa ta`ayyana `alaihil-qadhâ'u ba`dahû wa huwa dûnar-râbi`ati wal-`isyrîn, kâna `âliman `âmilan zâhidan wari`an taqiyyâ, wa kâna shâhiba-stiqâmatin wattibâ`in lil-Kitâbi was-Sunnah, wa kâna dzattisâ`in fil-`ulûm, akhadza `an `ulamâ'i `ashrih, minhumul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin Husain bin Thâhir wa akhîhi Thâhir, wa `aqadal-ukhuwwata wal-`ahda `alad-da`wati wat-ta'âzuri fîhâ ma`al-Habîb Muhammad bin Husainil-Habasyî wal-Habîb `Abdillâh bin `Umar bin Yahyâ, wantafa`a bihî khalqun katsîr, minhumul-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umaril-Habasyî wal-Habîb Ahmad bin Hasanil-`Aththâs, tuwuffiya bi-Saiwûn yaumal-itsnain 5 Ramadhân sanata 1290 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Muhsin bin ‘Alawi bin Saqqaf as-Saqqaf. Dilahirkan di Seiwun pada tahun 1211 H, beliau dididik oleh ayahnya dan diangkat sebagai qadhi menggantikannya saat usianya belum genap dua puluh empat tahun. Beliau seorang alim yang mengamalkan ilmunya, zahid, wara‘, dan bertakwa, pemilik istiqamah dan ittiba‘ kepada Al-Qur'an dan Sunnah, serta memiliki keluasan dalam berbagai ilmu. Beliau menimba ilmu dari para ulama di zamannya, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin Husain bin Thahir dan kakaknya, Thahir. Beliau mengikat persaudaraan dan perjanjian untuk berdakwah dan saling menolong di dalamnya bersama al-Habib Muhammad bin Husain al-Habsyi dan al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar bin Yahya. Banyak orang mengambil manfaat darinya, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar al-Habsyi dan al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-‘Attas. Beliau wafat di Seiwun pada hari Senin, 5 Ramadhan 1290 H.
passages.en: Imam Habib Muhsin bin Alawi bin Saqqaf as-Saqqaf was born in Seiyun in 1211 AH. He came to imitate his father in all his states and actions. He was appointed Qadhi after him when he was not even 24 years old. He was a scholar who acted on his knowledge, an ascetic, scrupulous, mindful of Allah, upright, and followed the Book and the Sunnah. He had vast knowledge. He took from the scholars of his time, such as Habib Abdullah bin Husayn bin Tahir and his brother Tahir. He, Habib Muhammad bin Husayn al-Habashi and Habib Abdullah bin Umar bin Yahya pledged brotherhood and mutual assistance in dawah. Many benefitted from him, such as Habib Aydarus bin Umar al-Habashi and Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas. He passed away in Seiyun on Monday, 5th Ramadhan in 1290 AH (1873).

passages.sub: Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب أبوبكر بن عبد الله بن طالب العطاس، ولد بحريضة سنة ١٢١٦هـ، كان إمامًا جليلًا عارفًا بالله، أخذ العلم عن كثير من العلماء، منهم: الحبيب أحمد بن عمر بن سميط والحبيب الحسن بن صالح البحر، وكان يذهب في صِغَره من حريضة إلى شبام للأخذ عن الحبيب أحمد بن سميط ويعود في ساعة أو ساعتين والمسافة بعيدة! تلقى عنه العلم كثير، منهم: أولاده والحبيب أحمد بن حسن العطاس والحبيب علي بن محمد الحبشي، أثنى عليه الأئمة العارفون واعترفوا بمقامه، ترجمه ابنه بمؤلف مستقل، توفي في ١٧ ذي القعدة سنة ١٢٨١هـ بحريضة.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Abûbakr bin `Abdillâh bin Thâlibil-`Aththâs, wulida bi-Huraidhah sanata 1216 H, kâna imâman jalîlan `ârifan billâh, akhadzal-`ilma `an katsîrin minal-`ulamâ', minhum: al-Habîb Ahmad bin `Umar bin Sumaith wal-Habîbul-Hasan bin Shâlihil-Bahr, wa kâna yadzhabu fî shigharihî min Huraidhata ilâ Syibâm lil-akhdzi `anil-Habîb Ahmad bin Sumaith wa ya`ûdu fî sâ`atin au sâ`ataini wal-masâfatu ba`îdah! Talaqqâ `anhul-`ilma katsîr, minhum: aulâduhû wal-Habîb Ahmad bin Hasanil-`Aththâs wal-Habîb `Alî bin Muhammadinil-Habasyî, atsnâ `alaihil-a'immatul-`ârifûna wa`tarafû bimaqâmih, tarjamahubnuhû bimu'allafin mustaqill, tuwuffiya fî 17 Dzil-Qa`dah sanata 1281 H bi-Huraidhah.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah bin Thalib al-‘Attas. Dilahirkan di Huraidhah pada tahun 1216 H, beliau adalah imam agung yang arif billah. Beliau menimba ilmu dari banyak ulama, di antaranya al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Umar bin Sumaith dan al-Habib Hasan bin Shalih al-Bahr. Di masa kecilnya, beliau biasa pergi dari Huraidhah ke Syibam untuk belajar kepada al-Habib Ahmad bin Sumaith dan kembali hanya dalam satu atau dua jam, padahal jaraknya jauh! Banyak yang menerima ilmu darinya, di antaranya putra-putranya, al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-‘Attas, dan al-Habib ‘Ali bin Muhammad al-Habsyi. Para imam ‘arifin memujinya dan mengakui maqamnya; putranya menulis biografinya dalam karya tersendiri. Beliau wafat pada 17 Dzulqa‘dah 1281 H di Huraidhah.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah bin Talib al-Attas was born in Huraydhah in 1216 AH. He was a great Imam and knower of Allah. He took knowledge from many scholars, such as Habib Ahmad bin Umar bin Sumayt and Habib al-Hasan bin Salih al-Bahr. In his childhood, he would go from Huraydhah to Shibam to take from Habib Ahmad bin Sumayt and return in an hour or two, even though the distance was great! Many received knowledge from him, such as his children, Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas and Habib Ali bin Muhammad al-Habashi. The Imams and knowers of Allah praised him and acknowledged his station. His son wrote a biography about him. He passed away on the 17th of Dhul Qadah in 1281 AH (1865) in Huraydhah.

passages.sub: Habib Aydarus bin Umar al-Habashi
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب عيدروس بن عمر بن عيدروس الحبشي، ولد بمدينة الغُرفة سنة ١٢٣٧هـ، ونشأ بها تحت رعاية أبيه وعمه محمد اللذين كانا من أبرز رجال تلك البلاد، وكان حبرًا راسخًا وطودًا شامخًا متبعا للكتاب والسنة، ذا أخلاق عالية، وكان يرى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو ابنُ ثمانِ سنين، أخذ العلم عن كثير، منهم الحبيب أحمد بن عمر بن سميط والحبيب عبد الله بن حسين بن طاهر وغيرهم، له مؤلفات عديدة ذكرَ مشايخه فيها منها: (عقدُ اليواقيت)، وأخذ عنه أكثر أهل الوقت وهو شيخ المتأخرين، توفي بالغُرفة ليلة الاثنين ٩ رجب سنة ١٣١٤هـ ولسانه لاهِج بلفظ الجلالة.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umar bin `Aidarûsil-Habasyî, wulida bimadînatil-Ghurfah sanata 1237 H, wa nasya'a bihâ tahta ri`âyati abîhi wa `ammihî Muhammadinil-ladzaini kânâ min abrazi rijâli tilkal-bilâd, wa kâna habran râsikhan wa thaudan syâmikhan muttabi`an lil-Kitâbi was-Sunnah, dzâ akhlâqin `âliyah, wa kâna yaran-Nabiyya shallallâhu `alaihi wa sallama wa huwabnu tsamâni sinîn, akhadzal-`ilma `an katsîr, minhumul-Habîb Ahmad bin `Umar bin Sumaith wal-Habîb `Abdullâh bin Husain bin Thâhir wa ghairuhum, lahû mu'allafâtun `adîdatun dzakara masyâyikhahû fîhâ minhâ: (`Iqdul-Yawâqît), wa akhadza `anhu aktsaru ahlil-waqti wa huwa syaikhul-muta'akhkhirîn, tuwuffiya bil-Ghurfah lailatal-itsnain 9 Rajab sanata 1314 H wa lisânuhû lâhijun bilafzhil-jalâlah.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar bin ‘Aydarus al-Habsyi. Dilahirkan di kota al-Ghurfah pada tahun 1237 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana di bawah asuhan ayahnya dan pamannya, Muhammad, yang keduanya termasuk tokoh paling menonjol di negeri itu. Beliau adalah ulama besar yang mendalam ilmunya, gunung yang menjulang kokoh, pengikut Al-Qur'an dan Sunnah, dan pemilik akhlak yang luhur. Beliau sudah melihat Nabi ﷺ sejak berusia delapan tahun. Beliau menimba ilmu dari banyak ulama, di antaranya al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Umar bin Sumaith dan al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin Husain bin Thahir. Beliau memiliki banyak karangan yang menyebutkan guru-gurunya, di antaranya ‘Iqd al-Yawaqit. Kebanyakan ulama pada masanya mengambil ilmu darinya, dan beliaulah syaikh para ulama muta'akhirin. Beliau wafat di al-Ghurfah pada malam Senin, 9 Rajab 1314 H, dengan lisan yang terus basah menyebut lafaz al-Jalalah (Allah).
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Aydarus bin Umar bin Aydarus al-Habashi was born in the town of al-Ghurfah in 1237 AH, and raised there under the care of his father and paternal uncle Muhammad who were among the most prominent scholars of the land. He was an authority and towering mountain in knowledge, who followed the Book and the Sunnah. He had lofty character. He would see the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, when he was eight years old. He took knowledge from many, such as Habib Ahmad bin Umar bin Sumayt, Habib Abdullah bin Husayn bin Tahir and others. He wrote several books in which he mentioned his Shaykhs, such as “Iqd al-Yawaqit”. Many of the people of his time took from him, and he is the Shaykh of those of latter times. He passed away in al-Ghurfah on Sunday night, 9th Rajab, in 1314 AH (1896), while his tongue was fervently mentioning the name of Allah the Majestic.

passages.sub: Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب أحمد بن حسن العطاس، ولد بحريضة سنة ١٢٥٧هـ، لاحظته العناية من صِغَره، أصيب برمد شديد فعمي، وانفتحت بصيرته، أخذ عن أئمة كثير منهم الحبيب صالح بن عبد الله العطاس الذي بشّر به أن يكون له شأن، والحبيب أبوبكر بن عبد الله العطاس والحبيب عبد الرحمن بن علي والحبيب محمد بن علي آل السقاف، وأخذ كذلك عن العلماء بالحرمين ومصر وغيرها، وكان لهُ دِربة في إصلاح ذات البين، وكان مُطّلِعًا على كثير من العلوم، لا يمر عليه وقت إلا في علم أو قراءة أو طاعة أخرى، أفرده غير واحد بترجمة، توفي بحريضة ٦ رجب سنة ١٣٣٤هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Ahmad bin Hasanil-`Aththâs, wulida bi-Huraidhah sanata 1257 H, lâhazhat-hul-`inâyatu min shigharih, ushîba biramadin syadîdin fa`amiya, wanfatahat bashîratuh, akhadza `an a'immatin katsîrin minhumul-Habîb Shâlih bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâsil-ladzî basysyara bihî an yakûna lahû sya'n, wal-Habîb Abûbakr bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâs wal-Habîb `Abdurrahmân bin `Alî wal-Habîb Muhammad bin `Alî Âlis-Saqqâf, wa akhadza kadzâlika `anil-`ulamâ'i bil-Haramaini wa Mishra wa ghairihâ, wa kâna lahû dirbatun fî ishlâhi dzâtil-bain, wa kâna muththali`an `alâ katsîrin minal-`ulûm, lâ yamurru `alaihi waqtun illâ fî `ilmin au qirâ'atin au thâ`atin ukhrâ, afradahû ghairu wâhidin bitarjamah, tuwuffiya bi-Huraidhah 6 Rajab sanata 1334 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-‘Attas. Dilahirkan di Huraidhah pada tahun 1257 H, penjagaan ilahi telah menaunginya sejak kecil. Beliau terkena penyakit mata yang parah hingga buta, namun mata batinnya justru terbuka. Beliau menimba ilmu dari banyak imam, di antaranya al-Habib Shalih bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas — yang memberi kabar gembira bahwa beliau kelak memiliki kedudukan besar — al-Habib Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas, al-Habib ‘Abdurrahman bin ‘Ali, dan al-Habib Muhammad bin ‘Ali Al as-Saqqaf, serta dari para ulama di al-Haramain, Mesir, dan lainnya. Beliau piawai dalam mendamaikan pihak yang berselisih dan menguasai banyak ilmu; tidak ada waktu yang berlalu kecuali diisi dengan ilmu, membaca, atau ketaatan lainnya. Tidak sedikit yang menulis biografi khusus tentangnya. Beliau wafat di Huraidhah pada 6 Rajab 1334 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas was born in Huraydha in 1257 AH. Divine providence watched over him from his childhood. He was afflicted with severe ophthalmia, and thus lost his physical eyesight, but his inner sight opened up. He took from many Imams, such as Habib Salih bin Abdullah al-Attas who gave good tidings that he would have a great affair, Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas, Habib Abdur Rahman bin Ali and Habib Muhammad bin Ali Aal as-Saqqaf. He also took from scholars of the two Sacred Sanctuaries, Egypt and elsewhere. He was skilled at reconciling people. He was adept in many sciences. His time would not pass except in knowledge, reading, or other obedience. A number of biographies have been written about him. He passed away in Huraydha on the 6th of Rajab, in 1334 AH.

passages.sub: Habib Ali bin Muhammad al-Habashi
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب علي بن محمد بن حسين الحبشي، ولد بقرية قَسَمْ سنة ١٢٥٩هـ، ونشأ وتربى بوالدته إذْ كان والده في الحجاز، انتقل إلى سيؤون سنة ١٢٧١هـ وسافر إلى الحجاز بأمر والده وأقام بها سنتين، أخذ العلم عن أئمة منهم والده والحبيب أبوبكر بن عبد الله العطاس وغيرهم، وكان ذا اجتهادٍ من صِغره، وأثنى عليه علماء عصره ومشايخه، انتفعَ به خلق كثير، كان إذا تكلم في مجلس وَعْظ.. بكى الناس عند استوائه قائمًا قبل أن يتكلم، أشار له شيخه أنه يكون مغناطيس القلوب، بنى رباط سيؤون ومسجد الرياض فيها، توفي يوم الأحد ٢٠ ربيع الثاني سنة ١٣٣٣هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Alî bin Muhammad bin Husainil-Habasyî, wulida biqaryati Qasam sanata 1259 H, wa nasya'a wa tarabbâ biwâlidatihî idz kâna wâliduhû fil-Hijâz, intaqala ilâ Saiwûn sanata 1271 H wa sâfara ilal-Hijâzi bi'amri wâlidihî wa aqâma bihâ sanatain, akhadzal-`ilma `an a'immatin minhum wâliduhû wal-Habîb Abûbakr bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâs wa ghairuhum, wa kâna dzajtihâdin min shighrih, wa atsnâ `alaihi `ulamâ'u `ashrihî wa masyâyikhuh, intafa`a bihî khalqun katsîr, kâna idzâ takallama fî majlisi wa`zh.. bakan-nâsu `inda-stiwâ'ihî qâ'iman qabla an yatakallam, asyâra lahû syaikhuhû annahû yakûnu maghnâthîsal-qulûb, banâ ribâtha Saiwûn wa masjidar-Riyâdhi fîhâ, tuwuffiya yaumal-ahad 20 Rabî`its-Tsânî sanata 1333 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Ali bin Muhammad bin Husain al-Habsyi. Dilahirkan di Desa Qasam pada tahun 1259 H, beliau tumbuh dalam asuhan ibunya karena ayahnya saat itu berada di Hijaz. Beliau pindah ke Seiwun pada tahun 1271 H, lalu berangkat ke Hijaz atas perintah ayahnya dan menetap di sana dua tahun. Beliau menimba ilmu dari para imam, di antaranya ayahnya sendiri dan al-Habib Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas. Sejak kecil beliau sangat bersungguh-sungguh, hingga para ulama di zamannya dan guru-gurunya memujinya. Banyak sekali orang yang mendapat manfaat darinya. Bila beliau hendak berbicara di majelis nasihat, orang-orang sudah menangis saat beliau berdiri tegak, bahkan sebelum beliau berbicara. Gurunya mengisyaratkan bahwa beliau akan menjadi magnet hati manusia. Beliau membangun Ribath Seiwun dan Masjid Riyadh di dalamnya. Beliau wafat pada hari Ahad, 20 Rabiuts Tsani 1333 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ali bin Muhammad bin Husayn al-Habashi was born in the village of Qasam in 1259 AH. He was raised and nurtured by his mother as his father was in the Hijaz. He moved to Seiyun in 1271 AH. He traveled to the Hijaz at the instruction of his father and stayed there for two years. He took knowledge from Imams, such as his father, Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas and others. He strove greatly from childhood. The scholars of his time and his Shaykhs praised him. Many people benefited from him. If he stood up to give a public speech, people would cry before he even opened his mouth. His Shaykh indicated that he would be a magnet of hearts. He built the Ribat of Seiyun, and the Riyadh mosque in it. He passed away on Sunday, 20th Rabi at-Thani in 1333 AH (1915).

passages.sub: Habib Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب أحمد بن عبد الرحمن بن علي السقاف، وُلد بسيؤون سنة ١٢٧٨هـ، وتربّى بأبيه الذي كان من كبار العلماء العاملين في وقته، ولازم الحبيب علي بن محمد الحبشي ليلًا ونهارًا، وأُخذَ عن الحبيب أحمد بن حسن العطاس وعن كثيرٍ من الشيوخ حتى فاقَ أقرانه، أملى تراجم عن شيوخه في كتابه (الأمالي)، قالَ فيه الحبيب علوي بن شهاب:
"والله ما في الأكوان مثل أحمد بن عبد الرحمن"
أخذَ عنهُ الكثير، منهم الحبيب محمد بن هادي السقّاف، وابنه الحبيب عبد القادر بن أحمد السقاف الذي جمعَ كلامه في مجلد وغيرهم، وكانَ ذا اجتهادٍ في ترتيب الأوقات مع قلّة المعاش، لا تمرّ عليه فترة من الفترات بدون فائدة، وكانَ له من النور ما يُبهر الألباب، توفي بسيؤون ٤ محرم سنة ١٣٥٧هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân bin `Alî as-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Saiwûn sanata 1278 H, wa tarabbâ bi'abîhil-ladzî kâna min kibâril-`ulamâ'il-`âmilîna fî waqtih, wa lâzamal-Habîb `Alî bin Muhammadinil-Habasyî lailan wa nahârâ, wa akhadza `anil-Habîb Ahmad bin Hasanil-`Aththâsi wa `an katsîrin minasy-syuyûkhi hattâ fâqa aqrânah, amlâ tarâjima `an syuyûkhihî fî kitâbih (al-Amâlî), qâla fîhil-Habîb `Alawî bin Syihâb: "wallâhi mâ fil-akwâni mitslu Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân" akhadza `anhul-katsîr, minhumul-Habîb Muhammad bin Hâdî as-Saqqâf, wabnuhul-Habîb `Abdul-Qâdir bin Ahmad as-Saqqâfil-ladzî jama`a kalâmahû fî mujalladin wa ghairuhum, wa kâna dzajtihâdin fî tartîbil-auqâti ma`a qillatil-ma`âsy, lâ tamurru `alaihi fatratun minal-fatarâti bidûni fâ'idah, wa kâna lahû minan-nûri mâ yubhirul-albâb, tuwuffiya bi-Saiwûn 4 Muharram sanata 1357 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman bin ‘Ali as-Saqqaf. Dilahirkan di Seiwun pada tahun 1278 H, beliau dididik oleh ayahnya yang termasuk ulama besar yang mengamalkan ilmunya di masanya. Beliau mendampingi al-Habib ‘Ali bin Muhammad al-Habsyi siang dan malam, serta berguru kepada al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-‘Attas dan banyak syaikh lainnya hingga mengungguli rekan-rekannya. Beliau mengimlakan biografi guru-gurunya dalam kitabnya, al-Amali. Al-Habib ‘Alawi bin Syihab berkata tentangnya, “Demi Allah, tidak ada di alam ini yang seperti Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman.” Banyak yang mengambil ilmu darinya, di antaranya al-Habib Muhammad bin Hadi as-Saqqaf dan putranya sendiri, al-Habib ‘Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf, yang menghimpun kalamnya dalam satu jilid. Beliau sangat bersungguh-sungguh menata waktunya meski hidup serba sederhana; tidak ada satu masa pun berlalu tanpa faedah, dan pada dirinya terdapat cahaya yang memukau akal. Beliau wafat di Seiwun pada 4 Muharram 1357 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman bin Ali as-Saqqaf was born in Seiyun in 1278 AH. He was educated by his father, who was one of the elect scholars who acted on their knowledge in his time. He kept the company of Habib Ali bin Muhammad al-Habashi night and day. He took from Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas and from many Shaykhs, until he surpassed his peers. He dictated the biographies of his Shaykhs for his book, “Al-Amali”. Habib Alawi bin Shihab said about him, “I swear, there is no one in the universe like Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman.” Many took from him, such as Habib Muhammad bin Hadi as-Saqqaf, and his son Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf who compiled his speech in a book, and others. He would strive to organize his time. He led a simple life. No time would pass without him gaining benefit. He possessed light that would dazzle minds. He passed away in Seiyun on 4th Muharram, 1357 AH (1938).

passages.sub: Habib Abdullah bin Umar al-Shatiri
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب عبد الله بن عمر بن أحمد الشاطري، ولد بتريم سنة ١٢٩٠هـ، ونشأ بها، وتلقى العلم عن كثير، منهم الحبيب علوي والحبيب عبد الرحمن آل المشهور والحبيب عيدروس بن عمر والحبيب علي بن محمد الحبشي ومكث عنده بالرباط أربعة أشهر والحبيب أحمد بن حسن العطاس، ورحل إلى الحرمين ومكث ثلاث سنين وبضعة أشهر مجتهدًا خلالها في حفظ أوقاته متلقيًا ما يقارب ثلاثة عشر مجلسًا في اليوم والليلة، ثم عاد وقام بعمارة دروس رباط تريم وانتفع به الجم الكثير، ومكث يُدرّس نحو خمسين سنة، توفي ليلة السبت ٢٩ جمادى الأولى سنة ١٣٦١هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Umar bin Ahmad asy-Syâthirî, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 1290 H, wa nasya'a bihâ, wa talaqqal-`ilma `an katsîr, minhumul-Habîb `Alawî wal-Habîb `Abdurrahmân Âlul-Masyhûr wal-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umar wal-Habîb `Alî bin Muhammadinil-Habasyî wa makatsa `indahû bir-ribâthi arba`ata asyhur wal-Habîb Ahmad bin Hasanil-`Aththâs, wa rahala ilal-Haramaini wa makatsa tsalâtsa sinîna wa bidh`ata asyhur mujtahidan khilâlahâ fî hifzhi auqâtihî mutalaqqiyan mâ yuqâribu tsalâtsata `asyara majlisan fil-yaumi wal-lailah, tsumma `âda wa qâma bi`imârati durûsi ribâthi Tarîm wantafa`a bihil-jammul-katsîr, wa makatsa yudarrisu nahwa khamsîna sanah, tuwuffiya lailatas-sabt 29 Jumâdal-Ûlâ sanata 1361 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar bin Ahmad asy-Syathiri. Dilahirkan di Tarim pada tahun 1290 H dan tumbuh besar di sana, beliau menerima ilmu dari banyak ulama, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Alawi, al-Habib ‘Abdurrahman Al al-Masyhur, al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar, al-Habib ‘Ali bin Muhammad al-Habsyi — di ribathnya beliau bermukim empat bulan — dan al-Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-‘Attas. Beliau merantau ke al-Haramain dan menetap tiga tahun beberapa bulan, dengan sangat menjaga waktunya hingga mengikuti sekitar tiga belas majelis ilmu dalam sehari semalam. Setelah itu beliau kembali dan memakmurkan pelajaran-pelajaran di Ribath Tarim; sangat banyak yang mengambil manfaat darinya, dan beliau terus mengajar sekitar lima puluh tahun. Beliau wafat pada malam Sabtu, 29 Jumadil Ula 1361 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abdullah bin Umar bin Ahmad al-Shatiri was born in Tarim in 1290 AH, and raised there. He received knowledge from many, such as Habib Alawi, Habib Abdur Rahman Aal al-Mashhur, Habib Aydarus bin Umar, Habib Ali bin Muhammad al-Habashi at whose Ribat he stayed for four months, and Habib Ahmad bin Hasan al-Attas. He traveled to the two Sacred Sanctuaries of Makkah and Madinah and stayed there for three years and some months, striving to use his time to receive from around 13 gatherings of knowledge everyday. He then returned and gave flourish to lessons in the Ribat of Tarim. A great number benefited from him. He taught for around 50 years. He passed away on a Friday night, on the 29th of Jumad al-Ula, in 1361 AH (1942).

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Hadi as-Saqqaf
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب محمد بن هادي بن حسن السقاف، ولد بسيؤون سنة ١٢٩٢هـ، ونشأ بها وتربى بوالده الذي كان محافظًا عليه من صِغَره ولم يفلتهُ للأغيار، وكان موزعًا أوقاته في قوالب الحفظ والتلقي والمطالعة، وأخذ عن كثير من العلماء، منهم الحبيب عبيدالله بن محسن السقاف والحبيب عيدروس بن عمر والحبيب علي بن محمد الحبشي ويُعدُّ شيخ فتحه، وأخذ عن علماء تريم والحرمين ومصر وصار علمًا يُستضاءُ به، وكان مع ذلك زاهدًا في الدنيا، ورعًا داعيًا إلى الله بحاله ومقاله، له مؤلفات نافعة وانتفع به كثير وجُمع كلامه ومواعظه، توفي ١٥ رجب سنة ١٣٨٢هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Muhammad bin Hâdî bin Hasanis-Saqqâf, wulida bi-Saiwûn sanata 1292 H, wa nasya'a bihâ wa tarabbâ biwâlidihil-ladzî kâna muhâfizhan `alaihi min shigharihî wa lam yuflit-hu lil-aghyâr, wa kâna muwazzi`an auqâtahû fî qawâlibil-hifzhi wat-talaqqî wal-muthâla`ah, wa akhadza `an katsîrin minal-`ulamâ', minhumul-Habîb `Ubaidullâh bin Muhsinis-Saqqâf wal-Habîb `Aidarûs bin `Umar wal-Habîb `Alî bin Muhammadinil-Habasyî wa yu`addu syaikha fat-hih, wa akhadza `an `ulamâ'i Tarîm wal-Haramaini wa Mishra wa shâra `alaman yustadhâ'u bih, wa kâna ma`a dzâlika zâhidan fid-dunyâ, wari`an dâ`iyan ilallâhi bihâlihî wa maqâlih, lahû mu'allafâtun nâfi`atun wantafa`a bihî katsîrun wa jumi`a kalâmuhû wa mawâ`izhuh, tuwuffiya 15 Rajab sanata 1382 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Muhammad bin Hadi bin Hasan as-Saqqaf. Dilahirkan di Seiwun pada tahun 1292 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana dalam didikan ayahnya yang menjaganya sejak kecil dan tidak melepaskannya kepada selain ahlinya. Beliau membagi waktunya dalam bingkai menghafal, talaqqi, dan menelaah. Beliau berguru kepada banyak ulama, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Ubaidillah bin Muhsin as-Saqqaf, al-Habib ‘Aydarus bin ‘Umar, dan al-Habib ‘Ali bin Muhammad al-Habsyi, yang terhitung sebagai guru futuh-nya. Beliau juga menimba ilmu dari para ulama Tarim, al-Haramain, dan Mesir, hingga menjadi panji ilmu yang menerangi. Bersama itu semua, beliau zuhud terhadap dunia, wara‘, dan berdakwah kepada Allah dengan keadaan dan ucapannya. Beliau memiliki karangan-karangan yang bermanfaat, banyak orang mengambil manfaat darinya, dan kalam serta nasihat-nasihatnya telah dihimpun. Beliau wafat pada 15 Rajab 1382 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Muhammad bin Hadi bin Hasan as-Saqqaf was born in Seiyun in 1292 AH. He was raised there by his father who watched over him from childhood and did not leave him to others. He divided his time between memorization, receiving knowledge and reading. He took from many scholars, such as Habib Ubaydullah bin Muhsin as-Saqqaf, Habib Aydarus bin Umar, and Habib Ali bin Muhammad al-Habashi, who is considered the shaykh from whom he received his opening. He also took from the scholars of Tarim, the two Sacred Sanctuaries of Makkah and Madinah, and Egypt. He became a scholar through whom people were enlightened. He was detached from the lower world, scrupulous, and a caller to Allah with his state and words. He wrote beneficial works. Many benefitted from him. His words and teachings have been compiled. He passed away on the 15th of Rajab in 1382 AH (1962).

passages.sub: Habib Alawi bin Abdullah bin Shihab
passages.ar: هو الإمام الحبيب علوي بن عبد الله بن عيدروس بن شهاب، ولد بتريم سنة ١٣٠٣هـ، ونشأ بها في بيت علمٍ وصلاح، وربّاه عمه محمد إذْ كان والده غائبًا بجاوة، اجتهد في تحصيل العلم، أخذ عن الحبيب عبد الرحمن بن محمد المشهور وتخرّج به وأخذً أيضًا عن علماء عصره، كان في بادئ أمره في قِلَّة من المعاش، وكان صابرًا محتسبًا شغلهُ طاعة مولاه، حتى فاق أقرانه وصارَ علمًا يُهتدى به، تصدّر مجالسَ تريم، وكان له الكشف والفراسة الصادقة يعرف ذلك من عرفَه، وكان له اتصال بأهل البرزخ وعِلقة قوية بهم، جُمعَ كلامه المنثور ومواعظه، توفي ١٢ رمضان سنة ١٣٨٦هـ ودُفن بزنبل.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb `Alawî bin `Abdillâh bin `Aidarûs bin Syihâb, wulida bi-Tarîm sanata 1303 H, wa nasya'a bihâ fî baiti `ilmin wa shalâh, wa rabbâhu `ammuhû Muhammadun idz kâna wâliduhû ghâ'iban bi-Jâwah, ijtahada fî tahshîlil-`ilm, akhadza `anil-Habîb `Abdirrahmân bin Muhammadinil-Masyhûr wa takharraja bihî wa akhadza aidhan `an `ulamâ'i `ashrih, kâna fî bâdi'i amrihî fî qillatin minal-ma`âsy, wa kâna shâbiran muhtasiban syaghluhû thâ`atu maulâh, hattâ fâqa aqrânahû wa shâra `alaman yuhtadâ bih, tashaddara majâlisa Tarîm, wa kâna lahul-kasyfu wal-firâsatush-shâdiqatu ya`rifu dzâlika man `arafah, wa kâna lahuttishâlun bi'ahlil-barzakhi wa `ilqatun qawiyyatun bihim, jumi`a kalâmuhul-mantsûru wa mawâ`izhuh, tuwuffiya 12 Ramadhân sanata 1386 H wa dufina bi-Zanbal.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib ‘Alawi bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Aydarus bin Syihab. Dilahirkan di Tarim pada tahun 1303 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana dalam rumah ilmu dan keshalihan. Beliau dididik oleh pamannya, Muhammad, karena ayahnya sedang berada di Jawa. Beliau bersungguh-sungguh menuntut ilmu, berguru kepada al-Habib ‘Abdurrahman bin Muhammad al-Masyhur hingga lulus darinya, dan menimba ilmu pula dari para ulama di zamannya. Pada awalnya beliau hidup serba kekurangan, namun beliau sabar dan mengharap pahala, menyibukkan diri dengan ketaatan kepada Tuhannya, hingga mengungguli rekan-rekannya dan menjadi panji petunjuk. Beliau memimpin majelis-majelis Tarim, memiliki kasyaf dan firasat yang benar — hal itu diketahui oleh siapa saja yang mengenalnya — serta memiliki hubungan dan ikatan kuat dengan ahli barzakh. Kalam dan nasihat-nasihatnya telah dihimpun. Beliau wafat pada 12 Ramadhan 1386 H dan dimakamkan di Zanbal.
passages.en: He is al-Imam al-Habib Alawi bin Abdullah bin Aydarus bin Shihab. He was born in Tarim in 1303 AH and was raised there in a house of knowledge and righteousness. His paternal uncle, Muhammad, educated him, as his father was away in Java. He strove to acquire knowledge. He took from Habib Abdur Rahman bin Muhammad al-Mashhur, and graduated under him. He also took from the scholars of his time. In the beginning, he had a very simple livelihood. He was patient and sought reward from Allah, and busied himself in obedience to his Lord. He then surpassed his peers and became a beacon of guidance. He presided over the gatherings of Tarim. He possessed spiritual unveiling and true inner sight that was known by those who knew him. He had a connection and strong attachment to the people of the interworld (barzakh). His words of prose and his counsels were compiled. He passed away on the 12th of Ramadhan in 1386 AH (1966). He was buried in Zanbal.

passages.sub: Habib Abu Bakr (al-Attas) bin Abdullah al-Habashi
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب أبوبكر العطاس بن عبد الله بن علوي الحبشي، ولد بقرية ثِبي من قُرى حضرموت سنة ١٣٢٨هـ، ونشأ بها تحت رعاية أبوَيْه، وكان والده من رجال العلم والولاية، ولُقِّب بالعطاس تيمنًا باسم الحبيب البركة أبي بكر بن عبد الله العطاس صاحب حريضة، وحفظ القرآن والمتون العلمية في صِغَره، وربطه والده بأشياخ عصره، منهم الحبيب عبد الباري بن شيخ والحبيب عبد الله بن عيدروس آل العيدروس والحبيب عبد الله بن عمر الشاطري والحبيب علوي بن عبد الله بن شهاب والحبيب أحمد بن عبد الرحمن السقاف وغيرهم، كما اعتنى به أخويه حسين وعلوي بعد والدهم، وكان يسير على قدمه منذ باكورة حياته من ثبي قادمًا إلى تريم منفردًا أو مع أخويه لطلب العلم ومجالسة العلماء، ومكث في رباط تريم مثابرًا على الطلب.
وكان له نصيب وافر من المجاهدة في العبادات بما يملأ شواغر وقته، وسافر إلى الحجاز، واستقر بمكة على ذات الوتيرة، وله بها ترتيب خاص لأوقاته ويفرح بمن يأتي إليه، وهو يحمل كتابه للقراءة عليه، فكان يطلب ممن يحمل كتابًا أن يقرأ حرصًا على عمارة الوقت بالانتفاع، له مصنفات نافعة، وخدمة لتراث السلف، توفي بمكة ٢٨ رجب سنة ١٤١٦هـ.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Abûbakrinil-`Aththâs bin `Abdillâh bin `Alawî al-Habasyî, wulida biqaryati Tsibî min quran Hadhramauta sanata 1328 H, wa nasya'a bihâ tahta ri`âyati abawaih, wa kâna wâliduhû min rijâlil-`ilmi wal-wilâyah, wa luqqiba bil-`Aththâs tayammunan bismil-Habîbil-barakah Abî Bakr bin `Abdillâhil-`Aththâs shâhibi Huraidhah, wa hafizhal-Qur'âna wal-mutûnal-`ilmiyyata fî shigharih, wa rabathahû wâliduhû bi'asyyâkhi `ashrih, minhumul-Habîb `Abdul-Bârî bin Syaikh wal-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Aidarûs Âlil-`Aidarûs wal-Habîb `Abdullâh bin `Umar asy-Syâthirî wal-Habîb `Alawî bin `Abdillâh bin Syihâb wal-Habîb Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân as-Saqqâf wa ghairuhum, kama`tanâ bihî akhawaihi Husain wa `Alawî ba`da wâlidihim, wa kâna yasîru `alâ qadamihî mundzu bâkûrati hayâtihî min Tsibî qâdiman ilâ Tarîm munfaridan au ma`a akhawaihi lithalabil-`ilmi wa mujâlasatil-`ulamâ', wa makatsa fî ribâthi Tarîm mutsâbiran `alath-thalab. Wa kâna lahû nashîbun wâfirun minal-mujâhadati fil-`ibâdâti bimâ yamla'u syawâghira waqtih, wa sâfara ilal-Hijâz, wastaqarra bi-Makkata `alâ dzâtil-watîrah, wa lahû bihâ tartîbun khâshshun li'auqâtihî wa yafrahu biman ya'tî ilaih, wa huwa yahmilu kitâbahû lil-qirâ'ati `alaih, fakâna yathlubu mimman yahmilu kitâban an yaqra'a hirshan `alâ `imâratil-waqti bil-intifâ`, lahû mushannafâtun nâfi`ah, wa khidmatun liturâtsis-salaf, tuwuffiya bi-Makkata 28 Rajab sanata 1416 H.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Abu Bakar al-‘Attas bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Alawi al-Habsyi. Dilahirkan di Desa Tsibi, salah satu desa di Hadhramaut, pada tahun 1328 H, beliau tumbuh besar di bawah asuhan kedua orang tuanya; ayahnya termasuk tokoh ilmu dan kewalian. Beliau dijuluki al-‘Attas untuk mengharap berkah dari nama al-Habib penuh berkah Abu Bakar bin ‘Abdullah al-‘Attas, shahib Huraidhah. Beliau menghafal Al-Qur'an dan matan-matan ilmu sejak kecil. Ayahnya menghubungkannya dengan para masyayikh di zamannya, di antaranya al-Habib ‘Abdul Bari bin Syaikh, al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Aydarus Al al-‘Aydarus, al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar asy-Syathiri, al-Habib ‘Alawi bin ‘Abdullah bin Syihab, dan al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf. Kedua kakaknya, Husain dan ‘Alawi, juga memperhatikannya sepeninggal ayah mereka. Sejak awal hidupnya beliau berjalan kaki dari Tsibi menuju Tarim, sendirian atau bersama kedua kakaknya, untuk menuntut ilmu dan duduk bersama para ulama, dan beliau bermukim di Ribath Tarim dengan tekun menuntut ilmu. Beliau memiliki bagian yang melimpah dari mujahadah dalam ibadah yang memenuhi seluruh waktu luangnya. Beliau lalu pergi ke Hijaz dan menetap di Makkah dengan pola hidup yang sama; di sana beliau memiliki tatanan waktu yang khusus, senang bila ada yang datang membawa kitab untuk dibacakan di hadapannya, dan meminta siapa pun yang membawa kitab untuk membacanya, demi memakmurkan waktu dengan manfaat. Beliau memiliki karya-karya yang bermanfaat dan berkhidmat pada warisan para salaf. Beliau wafat di Makkah pada 28 Rajab 1416 H.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Abu Bakr al-Attas bin Abdullah bin Alawi al-Habashi was born in the village of Thibi in Hadhramaut in 1328 AH. He was raised there under his parents' care. His father was one of the Imams of knowledge and sainthood. He was called “al-Attas” as a good omen after the name of Habib Abu Bakr bin Abdullah al-Attas of Huraydha who was a blessing. He memorized the Quran and texts of sacred knowledge in his childhood. His father connected him to the Shaykhs of his time, such as Habib Abdul Bari bin Shaykh, Habib Abdullah bin Aydarus Aal al-Aydarus, Habib Abdullah bin Umar al-Shatiri, Habib Alawi bin Abdullah bin Shihab, Habib Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf, and others. His brothers, Husayn and Alawi, also took care of him, after their father. He followed in his father's footsteps from the beginning of his life in Thibi. He would come to Tarim, either alone or with his brothers, to seek knowledge and sit with the scholars. He stayed at the Ribat of Tarim, relentless in his pursuit. His free time was spent striving in worship. He traveled to the Hijaz and settled in Makkah, continuing his pattern of organizing his time. He would be happy if people came to see him with books to study under him. He would ask anyone who had a book to read it to him, avid to fill his time with benefit. He authored beneficial works, and served the legacy of his predecessors. He passed away in Makkah on the 28th of Rajab 1416 AH (1995).

passages.sub: Habib Ahmad Mashhur bin Taha al-Haddad
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب أحمد مشهور بن طه بن علي الحداد، ولد بمدينة قيدون من وادي دوعن سنة ١٣٢٩هـ، ونشأ بها والتحقَ برباطها، وكانت والدته الشريفة صفية بنت طاهر الحداد من أفضل نساء عصرها عِلمًا وحِلمًا وسلوكًا، وهي التي غذّته ورعته وعلّمته وربطته بالرجال، وأخذ عن جملة من الأشياخ منهم العلّامة الحبيب عبد الله بن طاهر الحداد وأخوه العلّامة الحبيب علوي برباط قيدون، وأخذ عن الحبيب أحمد بن محسن الهدار والحبيب أحمد بن عبد الرحمن السقاف، وهاجر إلى جاوة وأخذ عن جملة من علمائها، ورحل إلى أفريقيا الشرقية وظهر بها عالمًا وإمامًا وداعية، فتح الله به قلوبًا، ودخل إلى الإسلام من معتنقي الأديان الآلاف ببركة دعوته وصدق نيته، وكان يتردد بين أفريقيا وبلاد الحرمين حيث يقيم بها أولاده.
وأخذ عنه الكثير من المُريدين بالجهات المذكورة، وله ارتباط وثيق بالحبيب عبد القادر بن أحمد السقاف حيث كانا يجتمعان في كثير من المجالس بجدة، ولهما رحلة موفقة إلى أفريقيا زارا فيها الحبيب عمر بن أحمد بن سميط، واستقر الحبيب أحمد بجدة حتى وفاته ١٤ رجب سنة ١٤١٦هـ ودُفن بمكة.
passages.tr: Huwal-Imâmul-Habîb Ahmad Masyhûr bin Thâhâ bin `Alî al-Haddâd, wulida bimadînati Qaidûn min Wâdî Dau`an sanata 1329 H, wa nasya'a bihâ waltahaqa biribâthihâ, wa kânat wâlidatuhusy-Syarîfah Shafiyyah bintu Thâhiril-Haddâd min afdhali nisâ'i `ashrihâ `ilman wa hilman wa sulûkâ, wa hiyal-latî ghadzdzat-hu wa ra`at-hu wa `allamat-hu wa rabathat-hu bir-rijâl, wa akhadza `an jumlatin minal-asyyâkhi minhumul-`allâmatul-Habîb `Abdullâh bin Thâhiril-Haddâd wa akhûhul-`allâmatul-Habîb `Alawî biribâthi Qaidûn, wa akhadza `anil-Habîb Ahmad bin Muhsinil-Haddâr wal-Habîb Ahmad bin `Abdirrahmân as-Saqqâf, wa hâjara ilâ Jâwah wa akhadza `an jumlatin min `ulamâ'ihâ, wa rahala ilâ Afrîqiyash-syarqiyyati wa zhahara bihâ `âliman wa imâman wa dâ`iyah, fatahallâhu bihî qulûbâ, wa dakhala ilal-islâmi min mu`taniqil-adyânil-âlâfu bibarakati da`watihî wa shidqi niyyatih, wa kâna yataraddadu baina Afrîqiyâ wa bilâdil-Haramaini haitsu yuqîmu bihâ aulâduh. Wa akhadza `anhul-katsîru minal-murîdîna bil-jihâtil-madzkûrah, wa lahurtibâthun watsîqun bil-Habîb `Abdil-Qâdir bin Ahmad as-Saqqâf haitsu kânâ yajtami`âni fî katsîrin minal-majâlisi bi-Jiddah, wa lahumâ rihlatun muwaffaqatun ilâ Afrîqiyâ zârâ fîhal-Habîb `Umar bin Ahmad bin Sumaith, wastaqarral-Habîb Ahmad bi-Jiddata hattâ wafâtihî 14 Rajab sanata 1416 H wa dufina bi-Makkah.
passages.id_: Beliau adalah al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad Masyhur bin Thaha bin ‘Ali al-Haddad. Dilahirkan di kota Qaidun, Wadi Dau‘an, pada tahun 1329 H, beliau tumbuh besar di sana dan bergabung dengan ribathnya. Ibundanya, asy-Syarifah Shafiyyah binti Thahir al-Haddad, termasuk wanita terbaik di zamannya dari segi ilmu, kesantunan, dan perilaku; beliaulah yang mengasuh, merawat, mengajar, dan menghubungkannya dengan para tokoh. Beliau menimba ilmu dari sejumlah masyayikh, di antaranya al-‘Allamah al-Habib ‘Abdullah bin Thahir al-Haddad dan saudaranya, al-‘Allamah al-Habib ‘Alawi, di Ribath Qaidun, serta al-Habib Ahmad bin Muhsin al-Haddar dan al-Habib Ahmad bin ‘Abdurrahman as-Saqqaf. Beliau berhijrah ke Jawa dan belajar dari sejumlah ulamanya, lalu merantau ke Afrika Timur dan tampil di sana sebagai alim, imam, dan dai. Allah membuka hati manusia melalui dirinya — ribuan pemeluk berbagai agama masuk Islam berkat keberkahan dakwahnya dan ketulusan niatnya. Beliau bolak-balik antara Afrika dan negeri al-Haramain, tempat anak-anaknya menetap. Banyak murid mengambil ilmu darinya di berbagai wilayah itu. Beliau memiliki ikatan erat dengan al-Habib ‘Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf; keduanya sering berjumpa di banyak majelis di Jeddah, dan keduanya menempuh perjalanan yang diberkahi ke Afrika untuk menziarahi al-Habib ‘Umar bin Ahmad bin Sumaith. Al-Habib Ahmad kemudian menetap di Jeddah hingga wafatnya pada 14 Rajab 1416 H, dan dimakamkan di Makkah.
passages.en: Al-Imam al-Habib Ahmad Mashhur bin Taha bin Ali al-Haddad was born in the town of Qaydun in the Daw'an valley in 1329 AH. He was raised there and joined its Ribat. His mother, al-Sharifah Safiyyah bint Tahir al-Haddad was one of the best women of her time in knowledge, clemency and conduct. She is the one who nurtured, taught and bound him to saints. He took from a number of Shaykhs, such as the erudite scholar Habib Abdullah bin Tahir al-Haddad, and his brother, also an erudite scholar, Habib Alawi, in the Ribat of Qaydun. He took from Habib Ahmad bin Muhsin al-Haddar and Habib Ahmad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf. He migrated to Java, and took from a number of its scholars. He traveled to East Africa, where he emerged as a scholar, Imam and caller to Allah. Allah opened hearts through him. Thousands of people following other religions entered Islam by the blessing of his call to Allah and his truthful intention. He would travel between Africa and the lands of the two Sacred Sanctuaries, where his children reside. Many spiritual aspirants took from him in the aforementioned lands. He had a firm bond with Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf. They would meet in many gatherings in Jeddah. They had a successful journey together to Africa. Together, they visited Habib Umar bin Ahmad bin Sumayt who was there. Habib Ahmad then settled in Jeddah until he passed away on the 14th of Rajab in 1416 AH (1995). He was buried in Makkah.

passages.sub: Habib Abdul Qadir bin Ahmad as-Saqqaf
passages.ar:
هو الإمام الحبيب عبد القادر بن أحمد بن عبد الرحمن السقاف، ولد بسيؤون سنة ١٣٣١هـ، ونشأ بها في حِجر أبويه، فقد كان أبوه إمام عصره، ووالدته الشريفة علوية بنت أحمد الجفري المرأة الصالحة المحبة للخير وأهله، فانفتحت عيناه على أسرار وأنوار العبادة والطاعة في محيطه ودربه، والتحق بِمِعلامة أجداده بسيؤون، تلقى فيها مبادئ الفنون على الشيخ طه باحميد، ثم انتقل عنها إلى مُجالسة والده الذي قرأ كتبًا كثيرةً عليه، والتحق بمدرسة النهضة العلمية تحت نظر والده، وحفظ بها القرآن، وتلقى وحقّق بها أنواع العلوم حتى تهيأ للتدريس فيها، والمشاركة في نَظارتها، كما برز متصدرًا بأمر والده للدروس بمسجد جده طه بسيؤون، وأظهر أثناء ذلك ما جعله قرة للعيون، وبعد وفاة أبيه في محرم سنة ١٣٥٧هـ قام بعده بِتَرِكة العلم والدعوة أتم قيام، وكان بيته ملجأً للأضياف يقوم لهم بفائق الإكرام، وأخذ العلم أيضًا عن أئمة عصره، منهم شيوخ التبرك مثل الحبيب عمر بن حامد السقاف والحبيب عبد الله بن عيدروس العيدروس وغيرهم، وشيوخ الأخذ مثل الحبيب محمد بن هادي السقاف والحبيب حامد بن علوي البار والحبيب عبد الله بن عمر الشاطري والحبيب جعفر بن أحمد العيدروس والحبيب عمر بن أحمد بن سميط وغيرهم الكثير، رحل في الدعوة إلى الله لعديد من المناطق مثل: شمال اليمن والعراق والشام ومصر وأفريقيا وجاوة وعمان والخليج العربي، ثم انتقل إلى جدة وحطّ الترحال بها، وكان يحضر ويُقيم العديد من المجالس والدروس بجدة ومكة والمدينة، ويلقي فيها من الوعظ ما تنصدع له القلوب.
وله ارتباطات عديدة بالرجال، وصلات وثيقة قائمة على مراتب الأخوة في الله ورسوله، ترجم له تلميذه الحبيب أبوبكر بن علي المشهور في ترجمة مُفردة، وفي آخر حياته طال صمته، واصْطلمَ لأعوام حتى توفي بجدة ليلة الأحد ١٩ ربيع الثاني ١٤٣١هـ ودُفن بمكة في المعلاة.
